### Priority Risk Areas (ranked)

1. **Post-prefill handoff to frozen replay + native KV retention** — The highest-risk seam is the first step after prefill, when code switches from Java-managed full outputs to frozen replay + native KV retention.
   - Files: `StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop.java`, `NativeDynamicShapePlan.cpp`, `NativeDynamicShapePlan_segments.cpp`

2. **Frozen-mode buffer reuse after nullify() suppression** — Commit `47a24d3ce4` changed `writeOutputSlot()` to free replaced plan-owned arrays and frozen execution skips `nullify()` to avoid per-step realloc/leak churn. If any op partially writes outputs, stale values can bleed across decode steps.
   - File: `NativeDynamicShapePlan.cpp`

3. **Output-slot ownership after outputSlots_/slotArrayCache_ unification** (commit `89d1f28925`) — Merging two caches into one could change when arrays are reused vs freshly allocated.
   - Files: `NativeDynamicShapePlan.h`, `NativeDynamicShapePlan.cpp`

4. **Triton replay gating and trait resolution** — Already caused one real quality bug (fixed in `634fabf1b7`), could regress.
   - Files: `NativeDynamicShapePlan_segments.cpp`, `TritonIRBuilder_sections.cpp`

- Decode loop: `StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop.java` in `nd4j/samediff-llm/src/main/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/llm/generation/`
- KV cache: `StaticKvCacheManager.java` + `DecoderUtils.java` + native retention in `NativeDynamicShapePlan.cpp`
- Flow: prefill → init static KV → rebuild/freeze DSP → native KV scatter → logits-only decode → greedy sample → next embedding → repeat

  1323	    /**
  1324	     * Compute argmax for all sequence positions in logits [1, seqLen, vocab] at once.
  1325	     * Returns int[] where result[p] = argmax over vocab dimension for position p.
  1326	     * Transfers the logits slice to host once (bulk D2H) then iterates locally.
  1327	     */
  1328	    private int[] argmaxAllPositions(INDArray logits, int numPositions) {
  1329	        int vocabSize = (int) logits.size(2);
  1330	        int[] result = new int[numPositions];
  1331	        // Get the [numPositions, vocab] slice and transfer to host once
  1332	        INDArray slice = logits.get(NDArrayIndex.point(0),
  1333	                NDArrayIndex.interval(0, numPositions),
  1334	                NDArrayIndex.all());
  1335	        // dup() creates contiguous copy of view, data().asFloat() does bulk D2H
  1336	        INDArray contiguous = slice.dup();
  1337	        float[] data = contiguous.data().asFloat();
  1338	        contiguous.close();
  1339	        for (int p = 0; p < numPositions; p++) {
  1340	            int offset = p * vocabSize;
  1341	            int topId = 0;
  1342	            float topVal = data[offset];
  1343	            for (int v = 1; v < vocabSize; v++) {
  1344	                float val = data[offset + v];
  1345	                if (val > topVal) {
  1346	                    topVal = val;
  1347	                    topId = v;
  1348	                }
  1349	            }
  1350	            result[p] = topId;
  1351	        }
  1352	        return result;
  1353	    }

  1442	    private void logLogitsDiagnostics(int step, INDArray logits) {
  1443	        try {
  1444	            INDArray lastLogitsDiag = logits.rank() == 3
  1445	                    ? logits.get(NDArrayIndex.point(0), NDArrayIndex.point(logits.size(1) - 1), NDArrayIndex.all())
  1446	                    : logits.getRow(0);
  1447	            // Use only getFloat() — CUDA reduction ops (min/max/mean/argmax) fail on
  1448	            // constant-flagged DSP output arrays. getFloat() works on any array.
  1449	            int len = (int) lastLogitsDiag.length();
  1450	            int topId = 0;
  1451	            float topVal = lastLogitsDiag.getFloat(0);
  1452	            float logitsMin = topVal, logitsMax = topVal;
  1453	            double logitsSum = topVal;
  1454	            boolean hasNaN = Float.isNaN(topVal);
  1455	            for (int i = 1; i < len; i++) {
  1456	                float v = lastLogitsDiag.getFloat(i);
  1457	                if (Float.isNaN(v)) hasNaN = true;
  1458	                if (v > topVal) { topVal = v; topId = i; }
  1459	                if (v < logitsMin) logitsMin = v;
  1460	                if (v > logitsMax) logitsMax = v;
  1461	                logitsSum += v;
  1462	            }
  1463	            float logitsMean = (float) (logitsSum / len);
  1464	            boolean allZero = logitsMax == 0.0f && logitsMin == 0.0f;
  1465	            StringBuilder first10 = new StringBuilder();
  1466	            int show = Math.min(10, len);
  1467	            for (int i = 0; i < show; i++) {
  1468	                if (i > 0) first10.append(", ");
  1469	                first10.append(String.format("%.4f", lastLogitsDiag.getFloat(i)));
  1470	            }
  1471	            log.info("  [DIAG] step={} logits: topId={} topVal={} min={} max={} mean={} hasNaN={} allZero={} shape={} first10=[{}]",
  1472	                    step, topId, topVal, logitsMin, logitsMax, logitsMean, hasNaN, allZero,
  1473	                    Arrays.toString(lastLogitsDiag.shape()), first10);
  1474	        } catch (Exception e) {
  1475	            log.warn("  [DIAG] step={} logits diagnostics failed: {}", step, e.getMessage());
  1476	        }
  1477	    }

  1479	    private static long percentile(List<Long> values, int percentile) {
  1480	        if (values.isEmpty()) return 0;
  1481	        List<Long> sorted = new ArrayList<>(values);
  1482	        Collections.sort(sorted);
  1483	        int idx = (int) Math.ceil(percentile / 100.0 * sorted.size()) - 1;
  1484	        return sorted.get(Math.max(0, Math.min(idx, sorted.size() - 1)));
  1485	    }

  1490	            NativeOpsHolder.getInstance().getDeviceNativeOps()
  1491	                    .getMemoryPoolStats(Nd4j.getAffinityManager().getDeviceForCurrentThread(), used, reserved);
  1492	            return used.get() / (1024 * 1024);
  1493	        } catch (Exception e) {
  1494	            return -1;
  1495	        }
  1496	    }

codex
The decode loop confirms the critical boundary: step 0 still requests logits plus present KV, then immediately invalidates and recompiles the DSP plan against static KV shapes, freezes it, and switches subsequent executions to logits-only if native KV retention config succeeds. I’m now verifying how that Java transition maps onto native “frozen” and output-slot reuse semantics.

    99	std::string normalizeOpName(const std::string& opName) {
   100	  std::string normalized = opName;
   101	  std::transform(normalized.begin(), normalized.end(), normalized.begin(),
   102	                 [](unsigned char c) { return static_cast<char>(std::tolower(c)); });
   103	  return normalized;
   104	}

   106	bool segmentBlocksPlanPhase(const GraphSegment& seg) {
   107	  return seg.def.isCapturable && !seg.exec.compilationFailed;
   108	}
   109	
   110	bool segmentIsCompiledSteadyState(const GraphSegment& seg, int minExecutionCountExclusive) {
   111	  if (seg.exec.currentPhase != ExecutionPhase::COMPILED) return false;
   112	  if (seg.exec.executionCount <= minExecutionCountExclusive) return false;
   113	
   114	  switch (seg.def.selectedBackend) {
   115	    case SelectedBackend::CPU_GRAPH:
   116	      return seg.resolvedCpuBackend != nullptr;
   117	    case SelectedBackend::GPU_COMPILER:
   118	      return !seg.exec.compiledByBackend.empty();
   119	    default:
   120	      return false;
   121	  }
   122	}

   129	int findProducerStepInSegment(const GraphSegment& seg, NativeSlot* slots, int outputSlotIdx) {
   130	  return dsp::findProducerStepInSegment(seg, slots, outputSlotIdx);
   131	}

   133	bool segmentHasInternalValueShapeInputs(const GraphSegment& seg, NativeSlot* slots) {
   134	  return dsp::segmentHasInternalValueShapeInputs(seg, slots);
   135	}
   136	
   137	bool segmentHasStablePointersForPlanPhase(const GraphSegment& seg, NativeSlot* slots) {
   138	  if (!segmentBlocksPlanPhase(seg)) return true;
   139	  const bool needsReplayInvariantTracking = segmentHasInternalValueShapeInputs(seg, slots);
   140	
   141	  switch (seg.def.selectedBackend) {
   142	    case SelectedBackend::EMULATED_REPLAY:
   143	      return seg.exec.argTableStable;
   144	
   145	    case SelectedBackend::CPU_GRAPH:
   146	      return seg.exec.currentPhase == ExecutionPhase::REPLAYING ||
   147	             segmentIsCompiledSteadyState(seg, 1);
   148	
   149	    case SelectedBackend::GPU_COMPILER:
   150	      if (seg.exec.currentPhase == ExecutionPhase::REPLAYING) {
   151	        const bool expectsReplayHandle =
   152	            seg.exec.replayHandle != nullptr || seg.exec.compiledByBackend == "Triton GPU";
   153	        if (!expectsReplayHandle) return true;
   154	        return seg.exec.replayHandle && seg.exec.replayHandle->isReady() &&
   155	               (!needsReplayInvariantTracking || seg.exec.argTableStable);
   156	      }
   157	      if (seg.exec.replayHandle && seg.exec.replayHandle->isReady()) {
   158	        return !needsReplayInvariantTracking || seg.exec.argTableStable;
   159	      }
   160	      return segmentIsCompiledSteadyState(seg, 1) &&
   161	             (!needsReplayInvariantTracking || seg.exec.argTableStable);
   162	
   163	    case SelectedBackend::CUDA_GRAPHS:
   164	    case SelectedBackend::SLOT_BY_SLOT:
   165	      return seg.exec.replayHandle && seg.exec.replayHandle->isReady();
   166	  }
   167	
   168	  return false;
   169	}
   170	
   171	bool segmentIsFullyReplayingForPlanPhase(const GraphSegment& seg, NativeSlot* slots) {
   172	  if (!segmentBlocksPlanPhase(seg)) return true;
   173	  const bool needsReplayInvariantTracking = segmentHasInternalValueShapeInputs(seg, slots);
   174	
   175	  switch (seg.def.selectedBackend) {
   176	    case SelectedBackend::EMULATED_REPLAY:
   177	      return seg.exec.currentPhase == ExecutionPhase::REPLAYING &&
   178	             seg.exec.argTableStable;
   179	
   180	    case SelectedBackend::CPU_GRAPH:
   181	      return seg.exec.currentPhase == ExecutionPhase::REPLAYING ||
   182	             segmentIsCompiledSteadyState(seg, 2);
   183	
   184	    case SelectedBackend::GPU_COMPILER:
   185	      if (seg.exec.replayHandle) {
   186	        return seg.exec.replayHandle && seg.exec.replayHandle->isReady() &&
   187	               seg.exec.currentPhase == ExecutionPhase::REPLAYING &&
   188	               (!needsReplayInvariantTracking || seg.exec.argTableStable);
   189	      }
   190	      if (seg.exec.currentPhase == ExecutionPhase::REPLAYING &&
   191	          seg.exec.compiledByBackend == "Triton GPU") {
   192	        return false;
   193	      }
   194	      if (seg.exec.currentPhase == ExecutionPhase::REPLAYING) {
   195	        return !needsReplayInvariantTracking || seg.exec.argTableStable;
   196	      }
   197	      return segmentIsCompiledSteadyState(seg, 2) &&
   198	             (!needsReplayInvariantTracking || seg.exec.argTableStable);
   199	
   200	    case SelectedBackend::CUDA_GRAPHS:
   201	    case SelectedBackend::SLOT_BY_SLOT:
   202	      return seg.exec.replayHandle && seg.exec.replayHandle->isReady() &&
   203	             seg.exec.currentPhase == ExecutionPhase::REPLAYING;
   204	  }
   205	
   206	  return false;
   207	}
   208	/**
   209	 * Returns the number of "structural" iArgs for an op — these are control parameters
   210	 * (masks, mode flags, axis indices) that are always passed via iArgs regardless of
   211	 * whether data parameters come from input tensors or from iArgs.
   212	 * Returns -1 if all iArgs are structural (the default for most ops).
   213	 */
   214	static int getStructuralIArgCount(const std::string& opName) {
   215	    static const std::unordered_map<std::string, int> STRUCTURAL_IARGS = {
   216	        {"strided_slice", 5},   // 5 mask bits (begin/end/shrink/new_axis/ellipsis)
   217	        {"concat", 1},          // axis
   218	        {"split", 1},           // num_splits
   219	        {"split_v", 1},         // axis
   220	        {"one_hot", 2},         // axis, depth
   221	        {"top_k", 1},           // k
   222	    };
   223	    auto it = STRUCTURAL_IARGS.find(opName);
   224	    return (it != STRUCTURAL_IARGS.end()) ? it->second : -1;
   225	}

   253	void NativeDynamicShapePlan::writeOutputSlot(int slotIdx, NDArray* value, const char* tag) {
   254	  if (slotIdx < 0 || slotIdx >= totalOutputSlots_) {
   255	    char buf[128];
   256	    snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "writeOutputSlot: index %d out of range [0, %d)", slotIdx, totalOutputSlots_);
   257	    THROW_EXCEPTION(buf);
   258	  }
   259	
   260	  NDArray* old = outputSlots_[slotIdx];
   261	
   262	  // DIAGNOSTIC: trace writes to the configured trace slot (ND4J_DSP_TRACE_SLOT)
   263	  if (DSP_DIAG_ENABLED(MEMORY) && planPhase_ >= PlanPhase::SHAPES_FROZEN) {
   264	    int ts = sd::graph::DspDiagnostics::getInstance().traceSlot();

   344	void NativeDynamicShapePlan::setGraphExecutionMode(GraphExecutionMode mode) {
   345	  DSP_REQUIRE_PLAN_PHASE_AT_MOST(PlanPhase::SLOT_BY_SLOT, "setGraphExecutionMode");
   346	  DSP_DIAG(EXECUTE, "setGraphExecutionMode: %d -> %d", static_cast<int>(graphExecutionMode_), static_cast<int>(mode));
   347	  graphExecutionMode_ = mode;
   348	  // Reset cached backends so mode changes take effect immediately.
   349	  gpuGraphBackendChecked_ = false;
   350	  gpuGraphBackend_ = nullptr;
   351	  cpuGraphBackendChecked_ = false;
   352	  cpuGraphBackend_ = nullptr;
   353	  cpuGraphBackendChainBuilt_ = false;
   354	  cpuGraphBackendChain_.clear();
   355	  // Enable GPU graph capture for all modes except SLOT_BY_SLOT.
   356	  // JIT backends (Triton/NVRTC/PTX) use graph capture when they
   357	  // can't handle a segment (unsupported ops, etc).
   358	  if (mode != GraphExecutionMode::GEM_SLOT_BY_SLOT) {
   359	    gpuGraphCaptureEnabled_ = true;
   360	  }
   361	  // Clear GPU backend failed-compilation cache so segments that failed with
   362	  // incomplete shapes (e.g., attention with seqK=0 before KV setup)
   363	  // can retry when called again with correct external input shapes.
   364	  clearGpuBackendFailedCache();
   365	}

   367	NativeDynamicShapePlan::~NativeDynamicShapePlan() {
   368	  DSP_DIAG(MEMORY, "~NativeDynamicShapePlan: START plan=%p numSlots=%d totalOutputSlots=%d planOwned=%zu",
   369	           this, numSlots_, totalOutputSlots_, planOwnedArrays_.size());
   370	
   371	  // ── Phase 1: Free GPU resources FIRST ─────────────────────────────────
   372	  // Platform GPU resources (replay handles, JIT kernels, cuBLAS workspace,
   373	  // batch-zero) may hold direct references into outputSlots_. Clean them
   374	  // BEFORE freeing slot arrays to avoid dangling pointer access during teardown.
   375	  DSP_DIAG(MEMORY, "~NativeDynamicShapePlan: freeing platform GPU resources");

   380	    if (seg.exec.symbolicRangeData != nullptr) {
   381	      freeSegmentShapeProfile(static_cast<SegmentShapeProfile*>(seg.exec.symbolicRangeData));
   382	      seg.exec.symbolicRangeData = nullptr;
   383	    }
   384	  }
   385	
   386	  // ── Phase 2: Free slot data ───────────────────────────────────────────
   387	  // Free slots metadata
   388	  if (slots_) {
   389	    delete[] slots_;
   390	  }
   391	
   392	  // Free release schedule
   393	  if (releaseAtStep_) {
   394	    for (int i = 0; i < numSlots_; i++) {
   395	      delete[] releaseAtStep_[i];
   396	    }
   397	    delete[] releaseAtStep_;
   398	  }
   399	  delete[] releaseAtStepCounts_;
   400	
   401	  // Free requested output mapping
   402	  delete[] requestedOutputSlotIndices_;
   403	
   404	  // Dedup set to prevent double-free (identity ops can share pointers across slots)
   405	  std::unordered_set<NDArray*> deleted;
   406	
   407	  // Free slot arrays. Only delete arrays that the plan created (in planOwnedArrays_).
   408	  // Arrays from external inputs or model variables are NOT plan-owned and must survive.
   409	  DSP_DIAG(MEMORY, "~NativeDynamicShapePlan: freeing outputSlots_ (%d slots, %zu plan-owned)",
   410	           totalOutputSlots_, planOwnedArrays_.size());
   411	  if (outputSlots_) {
   412	    int freedOwned = 0, skippedExternal = 0;
   413	    for (int i = 0; i < totalOutputSlots_; i++) {
   414	      if (outputSlots_[i] == nullptr) continue;
   415	      if (!deleted.insert(outputSlots_[i]).second) continue;
   416	
   417	      if (planOwnedArrays_.count(outputSlots_[i]) > 0) {
   418	        freedOwned++;
   419	        delete outputSlots_[i];
   420	      } else {
   421	        skippedExternal++;
   422	      }
   423	    }

   429	
   430	  // Free view producer flags
   431	  delete[] slotIsViewProducer_;
   432	
   433	  // Free context pool
   434	  if (contextPool_) {
   435	    for (int i = 0; i < numSlots_; i++) {
   436	      delete contextPool_[i];
   437	    }
   438	    delete[] contextPool_;
   439	  }
   440	
   441	  // Free owned legacy ops (created during deserialization for ops
   442	  // not registered in OpRegistrator, like exp, log, abs, etc.)
   443	  for (auto* legacyOp : ownedLegacyOps_) {

   447	  // Free untracked output cache

   450	      delete untrackedOutputCache_[i];
   451	    }
   452	    delete[] untrackedOutputCache_;
   453	  }
   454	
   455	  // Free KV cache mappings
   456	  delete[] kvCacheMappings_;
   457	
   458	  // Free control flow structures
   459	  delete[] loopRegions_;
   460	  delete[] slotIsDead_;
   461	
   462	  // Free slot buffer ownership metadata
   463	  delete[] slotOwnership_;

   465	  // ── Phase 3: Release references ───────────────────────────────────────
   466	  // Remove frozen reference counts from weight DataBuffers if the plan
   467	  // is still in frozen state when destroyed. This allows the buffers to

   487	  execState_ = nullptr;

   489	  DSP_DIAG(MEMORY, "~NativeDynamicShapePlan: DONE plan=%p", this);

   491	  // Finalize diagnostics AFTER all cleanup so destructor logging is captured

   493	  DspDiagnostics::getInstance().printPlanReport();
   494	  DspDiagnostics::getInstance().flushJsonReport();

   499	static const uint32_t DSP_MAGIC = 0x44535031;  // "DSP1"
   500	static const int32_t DSP_VERSION_MAX = 5;  // Max supported version
   501	
   502	/**
   503	 * Helper to read typed values from a byte stream.
   504	 */
   505	class BinaryReader {
   506	 public:
   507	  BinaryReader(const uint8_t* data, LongType size)
   508	      : data_(data), size_(size), pos_(0) {}
   509	
   510	  template <typename T>
   511	  T read() {
   512	    if (pos_ + sizeof(T) > static_cast<size_t>(size_)) {
   513	      THROW_EXCEPTION("BinaryReader: read past end of buffer");
   514	    }
   515	    T val;
   516	    std::memcpy(&val, data_ + pos_, sizeof(T));
   517	    pos_ += sizeof(T);
   518	    return val;
   519	  }
   520	
   521	  template <typename T>
   522	  void readArray(T* dest, int count) {
   523	    size_t bytes = count * sizeof(T);
   524	    if (pos_ + bytes > static_cast<size_t>(size_)) {
   525	      THROW_EXCEPTION("BinaryReader: readArray past end of buffer");
   526	    }
   527	    std::memcpy(dest, data_ + pos_, bytes);
   528	    pos_ += bytes;
   529	  }
   530	
   531	  std::string readString() {
   532	    int32_t len = read<int32_t>();
   533	    if (len < 0 || pos_ + len > static_cast<size_t>(size_)) {
   534	      THROW_EXCEPTION("BinaryReader: invalid string length");
   535	    }
   536	    std::string s(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(data_ + pos_), len);
   537	    pos_ += len;
   538	    return s;
   539	  }
   540	
   541	  size_t remaining() const { return size_ - pos_; }
   542	
   543	 private:
   544	  const uint8_t* data_;
   545	  LongType size_;
   546	  size_t pos_;
   547	};

  1602	    if (allStable) {
  1603	      pointersStable_ = true;
  1604	      const char* oldPhase = dsp::planPhaseName(planPhase_);
  1605	      planPhase_ = PlanPhase::POINTERS_STABLE;
  1606	      DSP_DIAG(EXECUTE, "PLAN_PHASE: %s → POINTERS_STABLE (frozenExec=%d)",
  1607	               oldPhase, frozenExecutionCount_);
  1608	    }
  1609	  }
  1610	
  1611	  // Promote to REPLAYING only once every replay-eligible segment has reached
  1612	  // steady-state replay. Mixed-phase plans stay at POINTERS_STABLE.
  1613	  if (planPhase_ >= PlanPhase::POINTERS_STABLE) {
  1614	    bool hasReplayEligibleSegment = false;
  1615	    bool allReplaying = true;
  1616	    for (auto& seg : segments_) {
  1617	      if (!segmentBlocksPlanPhase(seg)) continue;
  1618	      hasReplayEligibleSegment = true;
  1619	      if (!segmentIsFullyReplayingForPlanPhase(seg, slots_)) {
  1620	        allReplaying = false;
  1621	        break;
  1622	      }
  1623	    }
  1624	    if (hasReplayEligibleSegment && allReplaying && planPhase_ != PlanPhase::REPLAYING) {
  1625	      const char* oldPhase = dsp::planPhaseName(planPhase_);
  1626	      planPhase_ = PlanPhase::REPLAYING;
  1627	      DSP_DIAG(EXECUTE, "PLAN_PHASE: %s → REPLAYING (frozenExec=%d)",
  1628	               oldPhase, frozenExecutionCount_);
  1629	    }
  1630	  }
  1631	}

  1633	void NativeDynamicShapePlan::demotePlanPhase(PlanPhase targetPhase, const char* reason) {
  1634	  const char* oldPhase = dsp::planPhaseName(planPhase_);
  1635	  const char* newPhase = dsp::planPhaseName(targetPhase);
  1636	  DSP_DIAG(FALLBACK, "PHASE_DEMOTION: %s → %s: %s (frozenExec=%d)",
  1637	           oldPhase, newPhase, reason, frozenExecutionCount_);
  1638	  planPhase_ = targetPhase;
  1639	  if (targetPhase < PlanPhase::POINTERS_STABLE) {
  1640	    pointersStable_ = false;
  1641	  }
  1642	}

  1654	               (int)fusions.size());

  1667	             s.exec.replayHandle != nullptr, s.exec.compilationFailed, s.exec.executionCount);

  1669	
  1670	  planPhase_ = PlanPhase::SHAPES_FROZEN;
  1671	  pointersStable_ = false;
  1672	  frozenExecutionCount_ = 0;
  1673	
  1674	  DSP_DIAG(EXECUTE, "FROZEN_TRANSITION: unfrozen → FROZEN, "
  1675	            "%d segments, %d slots, %d extInputs, mergeSegments=%d, recompile=%d",
  1676	            (int)segments_.size(), numSlots_, numExternalInputs_,

  1689	    seg.exec.gapOpsCapturedInGraph = false;
  1690	    seg.exec.cachedShapeKey = 0;
  1691	    seg.exec.capturedInputAddrKey = 0;

  1693	    seg.exec.compilationFailed = false;

  1697	  for (auto* db : protectedWeightBuffers_) {

  1701	  if (outputSlots_ != nullptr) {

  1705	      }

  2005	void NativeDynamicShapePlan::clearShapeCaches() {
  2006	  // When shapes are frozen, skip clearing entirely after first execution.
  2007	  // All cached shapes remain valid since external input shapes are constant.
  2008	  if (shapesFrozen_ && executeCount_ > 0) return;
  2009	
  2010	  for (int i = 0; i < numSlots_; i++) {
  2011	    if (!slots_[i].shapeCache.shapeStatic) {
  2012	      slots_[i].shapeCache.cachedShapeKey = 0;
  2013	      slots_[i].shapeCache.cachedOutputShapes.clear();
  2014	      // Demote to WARMUP if currently beyond warmup (non-static slots need re-inference)
  2015	      if (slots_[i].state_ > NativeSlot::SlotState::WARMUP) {
  2016	        slots_[i].state_ = NativeSlot::SlotState::WARMUP;
  2017	      }
  2018	    }
  2019	  }
  2020	}

  2049	// ─── Release GPU intermediates ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  2050	
  2051	
  2052	int NativeDynamicShapePlan::releaseGpuIntermediates() {
  2053	  DSP_DIAG(MEMORY, "releaseGpuIntermediates: START plan=%p numSlots=%d totalOutputSlots=%d",
  2054	           this, numSlots_, totalOutputSlots_);
  2055	
  2056	  // ── Phase demotion: demote to SLOT_BY_SLOT BEFORE freeing any arrays ──────
  2057	  // This ensures no code path can observe POINTERS_STABLE/REPLAYING phase
  2058	  // while buffers are being freed, which would violate the phase contract
  2059	  // (those phases guarantee stable buffer pointers).
  2060	  {
  2061	    static const char* phaseNames[] = {"SLOT_BY_SLOT", "SHAPES_FROZEN", "POINTERS_STABLE", "REPLAYING"};
  2062	    const char* oldPhaseName = phaseNames[static_cast<int>(planPhase_)];
  2063	    static const char* reasonNames[] = {"NORMAL_CLOSE", "SESSION_RESET", "OOM_RECOVERY",
  2064	                                         "DEVICE_SWITCH", "CAPTURE_FAILURE", "SHAPE_CHANGE", "ERROR_RECOVERY"};
  2065	    const char* reasonName = reasonNames[static_cast<int>(destructionReason_)];
  2066	    if (planPhase_ != PlanPhase::SLOT_BY_SLOT) {
  2067	      DSP_DIAG(FALLBACK, "releaseGpuIntermediates: demoting planPhase_ %s → SLOT_BY_SLOT "
  2068	               "reason=%s before freeing arrays", oldPhaseName, reasonName);
  2069	      planPhase_ = PlanPhase::SLOT_BY_SLOT;
  2070	      pointersStable_ = false;
  2071	      frozenExecutionCount_ = 0;
  2072	    }
  2073	  }
  2074	
  2075	  // ── Step 1: Free per-segment GPU resources (CUDA graphs, capture workspaces,
  2076	  //            pinned host pointers) ──────────────────────────────────────────
  2077	  // This is the same cleanup as the destructor's platformFreePlanResources(),
  2078	  // but we keep the segment metadata (slot ranges, op definitions) intact.
  2079	  platformReleaseSegmentGpuResources();
  2080	
  2081	  // ── Step 2: Free non-weight NDArrays from outputSlots_ ─────────────────
  2082	  // Only free SLOT_OWNED buffers. Views and weights are externally owned.
  2083	  //
  2084	  //  Re-classify ownership before freeing. After CUDA graph capture,
  2085	  // outputSlots_[] is restored to warmup arrays (line 2716 in gpubackend.cpp)
  2086	  // but slotOwnership_[] still reflects capture-time classification. The warmup
  2087	  // arrays may have different ownership than the capture arrays:
  2088	  //   - Warmup array has unique buffer → should be SLOT_OWNED → must be freed
  2089	  //   - Capture array shared buffer with weight → was VIEW_OF_WEIGHT
  2090	  // Without re-classification, warmup arrays with unique buffers are skipped
  2091	  // (classified as VIEW_OF_WEIGHT from capture), leaking ~1.7 GB per page cycle.
  2092	  int freedCount = 0;
  2093	  std::unordered_set<NDArray*> deleted;
  2094	
  2095	  if (outputSlots_) {
  2096	    // Re-classify ownership for ALL slots based on the CURRENT outputSlots_[] arrays.
  2097	    // protectedWeightBuffers_ contains DataBuffers from ALL external inputs (built
  2098	    // during execute()). Any slot whose DataBuffer matches an external input is
  2099	    // BORROWED (model-owned, never freed by the plan). Everything else is an
  2100	    // intermediate (plan-owned, freed here).
  2101	    if (slotOwnership_) {
  2102	      for (int i = 0; i < totalOutputSlots_; i++) {
  2103	        slotOwnership_[i].reset();
  2104	        if (outputSlots_[i] == nullptr) continue;
  2105	        auto* db = outputSlots_[i]->dataBuffer();
  2106	        if (db == nullptr) {
  2107	          slotOwnership_[i].ownership = BufferOwnership::UNSET;
  2108	          continue;
  2109	        }
  2110	        if (protectedWeightBuffers_.count(db) > 0) {
  2111	          slotOwnership_[i].ownership = BufferOwnership::VIEW_OF_WEIGHT;
  2112	          slotOwnership_[i].dataBuffer = db;
  2113	          continue;
  2114	        }
  2115	        bool isViewOfSlot = false;
  2116	        for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
  2117	          if (outputSlots_[j] != nullptr && outputSlots_[j]->dataBuffer() == db) {
  2118	            slotOwnership_[i].ownership = BufferOwnership::VIEW_OF_SLOT;
  2119	            slotOwnership_[i].parentSlotIdx = j;
  2120	            slotOwnership_[i].dataBuffer = db;
  2121	            isViewOfSlot = true;
  2122	            break;
  2123	          }
  2124	        }
  2125	        if (!isViewOfSlot) {
  2126	          slotOwnership_[i].ownership = BufferOwnership::SLOT_OWNED;
  2127	          slotOwnership_[i].dataBuffer = db;
  2128	        }
  2129	      }
  2130	      DSP_DIAG(MEMORY, "releaseGpuIntermediates: re-classified ownership for %d slots "
  2131	               "(%zu protected external buffers)", totalOutputSlots_, protectedWeightBuffers_.size());
  2132	    }
  2133	
  2134	    if (slotOwnership_) {
  2135	      // First pass: null out all VIEW_OF_SLOT entries (they'll be invalidated
  2136	      // when their parent SLOT_OWNED buffer is freed).
  2137	      for (int i = 0; i < totalOutputSlots_; i++) {
  2138	        if (outputSlots_[i] != nullptr &&
  2139	            slotOwnership_[i].ownership == BufferOwnership::VIEW_OF_SLOT) {
  2140	          // Don't delete — the parent owns the buffer. Just null out.
  2141	          outputSlots_[i] = nullptr;
  2142	          slotOwnership_[i].reset();
  2143	        }
  2144	      }
  2145	      // Second pass: free SLOT_OWNED buffers that are plan-owned.
  2146	      // Only delete arrays the plan created (in planOwnedArrays_).
  2147	      for (int i = 0; i < totalOutputSlots_; i++) {
  2148	        if (outputSlots_[i] != nullptr &&
  2149	            slotOwnership_[i].ownership == BufferOwnership::SLOT_OWNED) {
  2150	          slotOwnership_[i].viewRefCount = 0;
  2151	          if (planOwnedArrays_.count(outputSlots_[i]) > 0 &&
  2152	              deleted.insert(outputSlots_[i]).second) {
  2153	            planOwnedArrays_.erase(outputSlots_[i]);
  2154	            delete outputSlots_[i];
  2155	            freedCount++;
  2156	          }
  2157	          outputSlots_[i] = nullptr;
  2158	          slotOwnership_[i].reset();
  2159	        }
  2160	      }
  2161	    } else {
  2162	      // Fallback: no ownership info — only free plan-owned arrays
  2163	      for (int i = 0; i < totalOutputSlots_; i++) {
  2164	        if (outputSlots_[i] != nullptr && planOwnedArrays_.count(outputSlots_[i]) > 0) {
  2165	          if (deleted.insert(outputSlots_[i]).second) {
  2166	            planOwnedArrays_.erase(outputSlots_[i]);
  2167	            delete outputSlots_[i];
  2168	            freedCount++;
  2169	          }
  2170	          outputSlots_[i] = nullptr;
  2171	        }
  2172	      }
  2173	    }
  2174	  }
  2175	  platformMigrateWeightsAndClearCaches();
  2176	
  2177	  // ── Step 5: Reset execution state so plan re-warms on next execute() ────
  2178	  viewProducerDetectionDone_ = false;
  2179	  frozenConstantDetectionDone_ = false;
  2180	  executeCount_ = 0;
  2181	  compilationDone_ = false;
  2182	  // Remove frozen reference counts from weight DataBuffers before clearing
  2183	  // shapesFrozen_. During frozen execution, addFrozenRef() was called on each
  2184	  // protectedWeightBuffer to prevent DataBuffer::migrate() from relocating
  2185	  // buffers whose addresses are baked into frozen slot contexts / CUDA graphs.
  2186	  // Now that all graphs and frozen state are torn down, migration is safe again.
  2187	  if (shapesFrozen_) {
  2188	    for (auto* db : protectedWeightBuffers_) {
  2189	      if (db != nullptr) {
  2190	        db->removeFrozenRef();
  2191	      }
  2192	    }
  2193	    
  2194	    // ALSO remove frozen ref count from all output slot DataBuffers.
  2195	    // These were protected during frozen execution to prevent SIGSEGV.
  2196	    if (outputSlots_ != nullptr) {
  2197	      for (int i = 0; i < totalOutputSlots_; i++) {
  2198	        if (outputSlots_[i] != nullptr && outputSlots_[i]->dataBuffer() != nullptr) {
  2199	          outputSlots_[i]->dataBuffer()->removeFrozenRef();
  2200	        }
  2201	      }
  2202	      DSP_DIAG(MEMORY, "releaseGpuIntermediates: removed frozen ref from %d output slot DataBuffers", totalOutputSlots_);
  2203	    }
  2204	  }
  2205	  // Reset shapesFrozen_ so the plan goes through the full warmup-capture-replay
  2206	  // lifecycle from scratch. Without this, stale segment state (shapeKey, cachedShapeKey)
  2207	  // causes Triton recompilation to be skipped, and the plan tries to replay
  2208	  // CUDA graphs that were destroyed, leading to error 700.
  2209	  shapesFrozen_ = false;
  2210	
  2211	  // Disable KV cache retention — after releasing intermediates, the output slots
  2212	  // that KV scatter reads from are NULL. The next page's decode loop will
  2213	  // re-configure retention at the correct position via configureKvCacheRetention().
  2214	  // Without this, a restored cached handle runs KV scatter with stale position
  2215	  // against empty destination buffers, causing CUDA error 700.
  2216	  kvCacheRetentionEnabled_ = false;
  2217	  kvCachePosition_ = 0;
  2218	
  2219	  // Clear shape caches so shapes are re-inferred
  2220	  clearAllShapeCachesForce();
  2221	
  2222	  // Clear GPU backend failed-segment cache
  2223	  clearGpuBackendFailedCache();
  2224	
  2225	  DSP_DIAG(MEMORY, "releaseGpuIntermediates: DONE plan=%p, freed %d arrays. "
  2226	           "Plan is now cold — next execute() will re-warm.", this, freedCount);
  2227	
  2228	  return freedCount;
  2229	}

  2231	int NativeDynamicShapePlan::releaseGpuIntermediates(bool preserveDecodeState) {
  2232	  if (preserveDecodeState) {
  2233	    // Decode-invariant path: preserve slot arrays, CUDA graphs, cuBLAS workspace,
  2234	    // and batch optimization resources. Only reset KV cache position and decode
  2235	    // input pending state.
  2236	    DSP_DIAG(MEMORY, "releaseGpuIntermediates(preserve=true): preserving decode-invariant state");
  2237	    
  2238	    // Reset KV cache position for next page
  2239	    kvCachePosition_ = 0;
  2240	    
  2241	    // Clear pending decode update flag
  2242	    hasPendingDecodeUpdate_ = false;
  2243	    pendingTokenId_ = 0;
  2244	    pendingCachePos_ = 0;
  2245	    
  2246	    // No GPU memory freed — returning 0
  2247	    return 0;
  2248	  } else {
  2249	    // Full release — call the existing method
  2250	    return releaseGpuIntermediates();
  2251	  }
  2252	}

  2254	// ─── KV cache retention ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  2255	
  2256	void NativeDynamicShapePlan::configureKvCacheRetention(
  2257	    const int* mappings, int numMappings, int maxKvLen, int initialPos) {
  2258	  // Free existing mappings
  2259	  delete[] kvCacheMappings_;
  2260	
  2261	  kvCacheNumMappings_ = numMappings;
  2262	  kvCacheMaxLen_ = maxKvLen;
  2263	  kvCachePosition_ = initialPos;
  2264	
  2265	  if (numMappings > 0 && mappings != nullptr) {
  2266	    kvCacheMappings_ = new KvCacheMapping[numMappings];
  2267	    for (int i = 0; i < numMappings; i++) {
  2268	      // Java passes either:
  2269	      //   >= 0 : requested output index
  2270	      //   <= -2: direct absolute slot index encoded as -(slotIdx + 2)
  2271	      int outputRef = mappings[i * 3];
  2272	      int slotIdx = -1;
  2273	      if (outputRef <= -2) {
  2274	        slotIdx = -outputRef - 2;
  2275	        if (slotIdx < 0 || slotIdx >= totalOutputSlots_) slotIdx = -1;
  2276	      } else if (outputRef >= 0 && outputRef < numRequestedOutputs_) {
  2277	        slotIdx = requestedOutputSlotIndices_[outputRef];
  2278	      }
  2279	      kvCacheMappings_[i].presentOutputSlotIdx = slotIdx;
  2280	      kvCacheMappings_[i].pastInputExternalIdx = mappings[i * 3 + 1];
  2281	      kvCacheMappings_[i].seqDim = mappings[i * 3 + 2];
  2282	    }
  2283	    kvCacheRetentionEnabled_ = true;
  2284	
  2285	    // Retained for compatibility with the platform hook; replay now uses the
  2286	    // canonical KV buffers directly so this is a no-op on every backend.
  2287	    platformMarkKvCaptureBuffersNeverSkip();
  2288	
  2289	    DSP_DIAG(KV_CACHE, "KV cache retention configured: %d mappings, maxLen=%d, initialPos=%d",
  2290	             numMappings, maxKvLen, initialPos);
  2291	  } else {
  2292	    kvCacheMappings_ = nullptr;
  2293	    kvCacheRetentionEnabled_ = false;
  2294	  }
  2295	}

  2326	void NativeDynamicShapePlan::setOutputSlotMaxSizes(const int* slotIndices, const LongType* maxSizes, int numSlots) {

I’ve confirmed one important shift in the native executor: there is no explicit per-step `nullify()` call in the current `NativeDynamicShapePlan` path. The executor now keeps one persistent array per slot across executions, which means any stale-data risk depends on whether an op fully overwrites its reused output buffer or relies on the old zeroing contract.

   740	inline bool anyInputDead(NativeSlot& slot, bool* slotIsDead, int slotIsDeadSize) {

   750	// Mark all outputs of a slot as dead
   751	inline void markOutputsDead(NativeSlot& slot, bool* slotIsDead, int slotIsDeadSize) {
   752	  for (int i = 0; i < slot.wiring.numOutputs; i++) {
   753	    int si = slot.wiring.outputSlotIndices[i];
   754	    if (si >= 0 && si < slotIsDeadSize) slotIsDead[si] = true;
   755	  }

   757	
   758	// Forward input[0] to all outputs (identity operation for Enter/Exit/LoopCond/NextIteration)
   759	inline void forwardInput(NativeDynamicShapePlan* plan, NativeSlot& slot, NDArray** outputSlots,
   760	                         int totalOutputSlots, NDArray** externalInputs, int numExt,
   761	                         const char* tag) {
   762	  NDArray* input = resolveCfInput(slot, 0, outputSlots, totalOutputSlots, externalInputs, numExt);
   763	  for (int i = 0; i < slot.wiring.numOutputs; i++) {
   764	    int si = slot.wiring.outputSlotIndices[i];
   765	    if (si >= 0 && si < totalOutputSlots) {
   766	      plan->writeOutputSlot(si, input, tag);
   767	    }
   768	  }
   769	}

  1237	    dsp::fnv1aMixValue(hash, static_cast<uint64_t>(val));

  1241	    NativeSlot& slot = slots_[s];
  1242	    for (int i = 0; i < slot.wiring.numInputs; i++) {
  1243	      int srcIdx = slot.wiring.inputSourceIndices[i];
  1244	      NDArray* arr = nullptr;
  1245	      if (srcIdx < 0) {
  1246	        int extIdx = -(srcIdx + 1);
  1247	        if (extIdx < numExt) arr = externalInputs[extIdx];
  1248	      } else if (srcIdx >= 0 && srcIdx < totalOutputSlots_) {
  1249	        arr = outputSlots_[srcIdx];
  1250	      }
  1251	      if (arr != nullptr) {
  1252	#if defined(SD_CUDA)
  1253	        mix(reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(arr->specialBuffer()));
  1254	#else
  1255	        mix(reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(arr->buffer()));
  1256	#endif
  1257	      } else {
  1258	        mix(0);  // nullptr sentinel
  1259	      }
  1260	    }
  1261	  }
  1262	  return hash;
  1263	}

   577	
   578	  LongType absoluteOffset = input0->offset() + viewOffset;
   579	  LongType sourceBufferElems =
   580	      input0->dataBuffer() != nullptr ? input0->dataBuffer()->getNumElements() : 0;
   581	  bool allowSubsetView =
   582	      slot.ident.op != nullptr && slot.ident.op->getOpDescriptor() != nullptr &&
   583	      slot.ident.op->getOpDescriptor()->hasAnyTrait(sd::ops::OP_TRAIT_SLICE);
   584	  bool elementCountCompatible =
   585	      allowSubsetView ? (outLen > 0 && outLen <= inLen) : (outLen > 0 && outLen == inLen);
   586	  bool fitsBackingBuffer =
   587	      absoluteOffset >= 0 && absoluteOffset <= sourceBufferElems &&
   588	      outLen <= (sourceBufferElems - absoluteOffset);
   589	
   590	  if (elementCountCompatible && fitsBackingBuffer) {
   591	    *outView = new NDArray(input0->dataBuffer(),
   592	                           const_cast<LongType*>(effectiveShapeInfo),
   593	                           LaunchContext::defaultContext(),
   594	                           absoluteOffset);
   595	    *outViewOffset = absoluteOffset;
   596	    if (traceSmallControl && DSP_DIAG_ENABLED(SHAPE)) {
   597	      DSP_DIAG(SHAPE,
   598	               "VIEW_TRACE_OK: slot %d (%s) zero-copy view created "
   599	               "inShape=%s outShape=%s inLen=%lld outLen=%lld offset=%lld",
   600	               stepIdx, slot.ident.opName.c_str(),
   601	               ShapeUtils::shapeAsString(input0).c_str(),
   602	               ShapeUtils::shapeAsString(effectiveShapeInfo).c_str(),
   603	               static_cast<long long>(inLen), static_cast<long long>(outLen),
   604	               static_cast<long long>(absoluteOffset));
   605	    }
   606	    return VIEW_CREATED;
   607	  } else if (outLen == 0 && inLen > 0) {
   608	    if (traceSmallControl && DSP_DIAG_ENABLED(SHAPE)) {
   609	      DSP_DIAG(SHAPE,
   610	               "VIEW_TRACE_FAIL: slot %d (%s) stale empty cached shape "
   611	               "inShape=%s outShape=%s inLen=%lld outLen=%lld",
   612	               stepIdx, slot.ident.opName.c_str(),
   613	               ShapeUtils::shapeAsString(input0).c_str(),
   614	               ShapeUtils::shapeAsString(effectiveShapeInfo).c_str(),
   615	               static_cast<long long>(inLen), static_cast<long long>(outLen));
   616	    }
   617	    return VIEW_STALE_EMPTY_SHAPE;
   618	  }
   619	
   620	  if (traceSmallControl && DSP_DIAG_ENABLED(SHAPE)) {
   621	    DSP_DIAG(SHAPE,
   622	             "VIEW_TRACE_FAIL: slot %d (%s) element/buffer mismatch "
   623	             "inShape=%s outShape=%s inLen=%lld outLen=%lld allowSubset=%d absoluteOffset=%lld "
   624	             "sourceBufferElems=%lld fitsBackingBuffer=%d",
   625	             stepIdx, slot.ident.opName.c_str(),
   626	             ShapeUtils::shapeAsString(input0).c_str(),
   627	             ShapeUtils::shapeAsString(effectiveShapeInfo).c_str(),
   628	             static_cast<long long>(inLen), static_cast<long long>(outLen),
   629	             allowSubsetView ? 1 : 0,
   630	             static_cast<long long>(absoluteOffset),
   631	             static_cast<long long>(sourceBufferElems),
   632	             fitsBackingBuffer ? 1 : 0);
   633	  }
   634	
   635	  return VIEW_NOT_POSSIBLE;
   636	}

   640	// ─── Frozen constant detection ──────────────────────────────────────────────
   641	// After the warmup execution (executeCount_ just went from 0 to 1), identify
   642	// slots whose output never changes between decode steps. These slots are
   643	// skipped entirely during subsequent executions (including graph capture),
   644	// removing their kernels, memsets, and memcpys from the captured graph.
   645	
   646	void NativeDynamicShapePlan::detectFrozenConstants() {
   647	  if (!shapesFrozen_ || executeCount_ != 1 || frozenConstantDetectionDone_) return;
   648	  frozenConstantDetectionDone_ = true;
   649	
   650	  // Ops whose output depends ONLY on input shapes, not input values.
   651	  // When shapes are frozen, these produce identical output every step.
   652	  // Classification now comes from OpDescriptor traits (OP_TRAIT_SHAPE_ONLY_OUTPUT).
   653	
   654	  std::vector<bool> dependsOnExternal(totalOutputSlots_, false);
   655	  std::vector<bool> isValueIndependentSlot(numSlots_, false);
   656	
   657	  // Propagate external dependency through the graph (topological order).
   658	  // Value-independent ops do NOT propagate dependency — their outputs
   659	  // are constant when shapes are frozen.
   660	  for (int s = 0; s < numSlots_; s++) {
   661	    auto& sl = slots_[s];
   662	
   663	    // Check if this op is value-independent via trait
   664	    bool isShapeOnly = (sl.ident.op && sl.ident.op->getOpDescriptor() &&
   665	                        sl.ident.op->getOpDescriptor()->hasAnyTrait(sd::ops::OP_TRAIT_SHAPE_ONLY_OUTPUT));
   666	    if (isShapeOnly) {
   667	      isValueIndependentSlot[s] = true;
   668	      continue;
   669	    }
   670	
   671	    bool anyInputDependsOnExternal = false;
   672	    for (int i = 0; i < sl.wiring.numInputs; i++) {
   673	      int srcIdx = sl.wiring.inputSourceIndices[i];
   674	      if (srcIdx < 0) {
   675	        anyInputDependsOnExternal = true;
   676	        break;
   677	      }
   678	      if (srcIdx < totalOutputSlots_ && dependsOnExternal[srcIdx]) {
   679	        anyInputDependsOnExternal = true;
   680	        break;
   681	      }
   682	    }
   683	    if (anyInputDependsOnExternal) {
   684	      for (int o = 0; o < sl.wiring.numOutputs; o++) {
   685	        int si = sl.wiring.outputSlotIndices[o];
   686	        if (si >= 0 && si < totalOutputSlots_) {
   687	          dependsOnExternal[si] = true;
   688	        }
   689	      }
   690	    }
   691	  }
   692	
   693	  int frozenConstCount = 0;
   694	  int valueIndepCount = 0;
   695	  for (int s = 0; s < numSlots_; s++) {
   696	    auto& sl = slots_[s];
   697	    bool allOutputsConstant = true;
   698	    for (int o = 0; o < sl.wiring.numOutputs; o++) {
   699	      int si = sl.wiring.outputSlotIndices[o];
   700	      if (si >= 0 && si < totalOutputSlots_ && dependsOnExternal[si]) {
   701	        allOutputsConstant = false;
   702	        break;
   703	      }
   704	    }
   705	    if (allOutputsConstant && !sl.flags.isDataDependent) {
   706	      sl.state_ = NativeSlot::SlotState::FROZEN_CONSTANT;
   707	      frozenConstCount++;
   708	      if (isValueIndependentSlot[s]) valueIndepCount++;
   709	    }
   710	  }
   711	  // Collect frozen output slot indices for quick lookup
   712	  std::unordered_set<int> frozenOutputSlots;
   713	  for (int s = 0; s < numSlots_; s++) {
   714	    if (slots_[s].frozenConstantSlot()) {
   715	      for (int o = 0; o < slots_[s].wiring.numOutputs; o++) {
   716	        frozenOutputSlots.insert(slots_[s].wiring.outputSlotIndices[o]);
   717	      }
   718	    }
   719	  }
   720	
   721	  // Un-freeze any frozen constant whose output DataBuffer is shared (via view aliasing)
   722	  // with a non-frozen slot's output. View-producing ops (reshape, expand_dims, etc.)
   723	  // create outputs that share their input's DataBuffer. If the frozen constant's output
   724	  // is a view of a non-frozen slot's buffer, the non-frozen slot can overwrite the buffer
   725	  // on subsequent steps, corrupting the frozen constant's data.
   726	  // Example: shape_of → concat → reshape(view) chain where reshape shares concat's buffer,
   727	  // and a downstream non-frozen op writes to the same buffer region.
   728	  int viewAliasUnfrozen = 0;
   729	  {
   730	    // Build a set of DataBuffer pointers owned by non-frozen output slots
   731	    std::unordered_set<const void*> nonFrozenBuffers;
   732	    for (int si = 0; si < totalOutputSlots_; si++) {
   733	      if (!frozenOutputSlots.count(si) && outputSlots_[si] != nullptr
   734	          && outputSlots_[si]->dataBuffer() != nullptr) {
   735	        nonFrozenBuffers.insert(
   736	            static_cast<const void*>(outputSlots_[si]->dataBuffer()));
   737	      }
   738	    }
   739	    // Check each frozen constant's outputs for buffer aliasing
   740	    for (int s = 0; s < numSlots_; s++) {
   741	      auto& sl = slots_[s];
   742	      if (!sl.frozenConstantSlot()) continue;
   743	      bool aliased = false;
   744	      for (int o = 0; o < sl.wiring.numOutputs; o++) {
   745	        int si = sl.wiring.outputSlotIndices[o];
   746	        if (si >= 0 && si < totalOutputSlots_ && outputSlots_[si] != nullptr
   747	            && outputSlots_[si]->dataBuffer() != nullptr) {
   748	          const void* bufPtr = static_cast<const void*>(
   749	              outputSlots_[si]->dataBuffer());
   750	          if (nonFrozenBuffers.count(bufPtr)) {
   751	            aliased = true;
   752	            break;
   753	          }
   754	        }
   755	      }
   756	      if (aliased) {
   757	        sl.state_ = NativeSlot::SlotState::SHAPE_CACHED;
   758	        // Remove from frozenOutputSlots
   759	        for (int o = 0; o < sl.wiring.numOutputs; o++) {
   760	          frozenOutputSlots.erase(sl.wiring.outputSlotIndices[o]);
   761	        }
   762	        viewAliasUnfrozen++;
   763	        frozenConstCount--;
   764	      }
   765	    }
   766	  }
   767	
   768	  // Disable in-place fusion for any op that would overwrite a frozen output buffer.
   769	  // In-place fusion writes the op's output directly into its input buffer.
   770	  // If that input comes from a frozen constant slot, the frozen value gets corrupted.
   771	  // Note: in-place fusion disabling for frozen slots is now done earlier in
   772	  // rebuildSegmentsForFrozenShapes() (before the warmup), so the warmup doesn't
   773	  // corrupt cached frozen values. The code here is a safety net for any case
   774	  // where rebuildSegments wasn't called before frozen detection.
   775	  int disabledInPlace = 0;
   776	  for (int s = 0; s < numSlots_; s++) {
   777	    auto& sl = slots_[s];
   778	    if (sl.flags.inPlaceFused && sl.flags.inPlaceFusedInputIdx >= 0 &&
   779	        sl.flags.inPlaceFusedInputIdx < sl.wiring.numInputs) {
   780	      int srcSlot = sl.wiring.inputSourceIndices[sl.flags.inPlaceFusedInputIdx];
   781	      if (srcSlot >= 0 && frozenOutputSlots.count(srcSlot)) {
   782	        sl.flags.inPlaceFused = false;
   783	        sl.flags.inPlaceFusedInputIdx = -1;
   784	        disabledInPlace++;
   785	      }
   786	    }
   787	  }
   788	
   789	  DSP_DIAG(SHAPE, "frozen constant detection: %d/%d slots are frozen constants (%d value-independent, %d in-place disabled, %d view-alias unfrozen)",
   790	            frozenConstCount, numSlots_, valueIndepCount, disabledInPlace, viewAliasUnfrozen);
   791	
   792	  // Log external-dependency summary for frozen constant debugging.
   793	  if (DSP_DIAG_ENABLED(SHAPE)) {
   794	    int extDepCount = 0;
   795	    for (int si = 0; si < totalOutputSlots_; si++) {
   796	      if (dependsOnExternal[si]) extDepCount++;
   797	    }
   798	    DSP_DIAG(SHAPE, "frozen constant detection: %d/%d output slots depend on external input",
   799	             extDepCount, totalOutputSlots_);
   800	
   801	    // At FULL level, log per-slot details for the configured trace slot (if any).
   802	    int ts = DspDiagnostics::getInstance().traceSlot();
   803	    if (ts >= 0 && ts < totalOutputSlots_) {
   804	      bool depExt = dependsOnExternal[ts];
   805	      int producingStep = -1;
   806	      bool isFrozenConst = false, isShapeStatic = false;
   807	      for (int s = 0; s < numSlots_; s++) {
   808	        for (int o = 0; o < slots_[s].wiring.numOutputs; o++) {
   809	          if (slots_[s].wiring.outputSlotIndices[o] == ts) {
   810	            producingStep = s;
   811	            isFrozenConst = slots_[s].frozenConstantSlot();
   812	            isShapeStatic = slots_[s].shapeCache.shapeStatic;
   813	            goto foundTraceStep;
   814	          }
   815	        }
   816	      }
   817	      foundTraceStep:;
   818	      DSP_DIAG(SHAPE, "trace slot outSlot=%d dependsOnExternal=%d "
   819	               "producingStep=%d frozenConst=%d shapeStatic=%d opName=%s",
   820	               ts, depExt ? 1 : 0, producingStep,
   821	               isFrozenConst ? 1 : 0, isShapeStatic ? 1 : 0,
   822	               producingStep >= 0 ? slots_[producingStep].ident.opName.c_str() : "?");
   823	    }
   824	  }
   825	}

   827	// ─── Shape key computation ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
   828	
   829	LongType NativeDynamicShapePlan::computeShapeKey(
   830	    NativeSlot& slot, NDArray** inputs, int numInputs) {
   831	  uint64_t key = dsp::FNV1A64_OFFSET_BASIS;
   832	  auto mix = [&key](LongType val) {
   833	    dsp::fnv1aMixValue(key, static_cast<uint64_t>(val));
   834	  };
   835	
   836	  // Mix op identity
   837	  mix(slot.ident.opHash);
   838	
   839	  // Mix input shapes, dtypes, and empty flag
   840	  for (int i = 0; i < numInputs; i++) {
   841	    if (inputs[i] == nullptr) continue;
   842	    const LongType* si = inputs[i]->shapeInfo();
   843	    LongType rank = shape::rank(si);
   844	    mix(rank);
   845	    for (int d = 0; d < rank; d++) {
   846	      mix(si[d + 1]);
   847	    }
   848	    mix(static_cast<LongType>(inputs[i]->dataType()));
   849	    // Include ARRAY_EMPTY flag — an input transitioning from empty to
   850	    // non-empty with the same dimensions must produce a different key.
   851	    mix(static_cast<LongType>(inputs[i]->isEmpty() ? 1 : 0));
   852	  }
   853	
   854	  // Also mix literal values for tiny integer/bool inputs.
   855	  // These arrays are commonly shape/control tensors; their shape often stays
   856	  // constant while values change across decode steps (e.g., KV length growth).
   857	  for (int i = 0; i < numInputs; i++) {
   858	    if (inputs[i] == nullptr) continue;
   859	    auto dt = inputs[i]->dataType();
   860	    auto len = inputs[i]->lengthOf();
   861	    if ((dt == INT32 || dt == INT64 || dt == BOOL) && len > 0 && len <= 32) {
   862	      inputs[i]->syncToHost();
   863	      for (LongType j = 0; j < len; j++) {
   864	        if (dt == BOOL) {
   865	          mix(static_cast<LongType>(inputs[i]->e<bool>(j)));
   866	        } else {
   867	          mix(inputs[i]->e<LongType>(j));
   868	        }
   869	      }
   870	    }
   871	  }
   872	
   873	  return key;
   874	}

   876	// ─── Per-slot execution ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   877	
   878	Status NativeDynamicShapePlan::executeSlot(
   879	    int stepIdx, NDArray** externalArrays, int numExt, void* stream) {
   880	  NativeSlot& slot = slots_[stepIdx];
   881	
   882	  // DIAGNOSTIC: trace entry for controller slots
   883	  bool traceEntry = DSP_DIAG_ENABLED(SHAPE) &&
   884	      (stepIdx == 349 || stepIdx == 350 || stepIdx == 357 || stepIdx == 358);
   885	  if (traceEntry) {
   886	    DSP_DIAG_SLOT(SHAPE, stepIdx,
   887	        "EXEC_SLOT_ENTRY: slot %d (%s) state=%d frozenContextReady=%d shapeValid=%d "
   888	        "isViewCapable=%d isDataDep=%d outputShapeDep=%d execCount=%d shapesFrozen=%d",
   889	        stepIdx, slot.ident.opName.c_str(),
   890	        (int)slot.state_,
   891	        slot.frozenContextReady() ? 1 : 0,
   892	        slot.shapeCacheValid() ? 1 : 0,
   893	        slot.flags.isViewCapableOp ? 1 : 0,
   894	        slot.flags.isDataDependent ? 1 : 0,
   895	        slot.flags.outputShapeDependsOnInputValues ? 1 : 0,
   896	        executeCount_,
   897	        shapesFrozen_ ? 1 : 0);
   898	  }
   899	
   900	  auto discardCachedSlotArray = [&](int slotIdx, NDArray* cached, const char* tag) {
   901	    if (cached == nullptr) return;
   902	
   903	    // In Phase 2, slotArrayCache_ aliases outputSlots_. Clearing the live slot
   904	    // before deleting avoids leaving a dangling NDArray wrapper behind when a
   905	    // shape transition forces inline replacement.
   906	    if (slotArrayCache_ == outputSlots_ &&
   907	        slotIdx >= 0 && slotIdx < totalOutputSlots_ &&
   908	        outputSlots_[slotIdx] == cached) {
   909	      outputSlots_[slotIdx] = nullptr;
   910	      if (slotOwnership_ != nullptr) {
   911	        slotOwnership_[slotIdx].reset();
   912	      }
   913	    }
   914	
   915	    if (!tl_graphExecutionActive && !isSlotArrayShared(cached, slotIdx)) {
   916	      planOwnedArrays_.erase(cached);
   917	      delete cached;
   918	      DSP_DIAG(MEMORY, "discardCachedSlotArray: slot=%d tag=%s deleted=%p",
   919	               slotIdx, tag, (void*)cached);
   920	    } else {
   921	      DSP_DIAG(MEMORY, "discardCachedSlotArray: slot=%d tag=%s preserved=%p sharedOrCapturing=%d",
   922	               slotIdx, tag, (void*)cached,
   923	               (tl_graphExecutionActive || isSlotArrayShared(cached, slotIdx)) ? 1 : 0);
   924	    }
   925	
   926	    if (slotIdx >= 0 && slotIdx < totalOutputSlots_) {
   927	      slotArrayCache_[slotIdx] = nullptr;
   928	    }
   929	  };
   930	
   931	  auto validateReusableSlotArray = [&](int slotIdx, NDArray* cached,
   932	                                       const char* tag) -> NDArray* {
   933	    if (cached == nullptr) return nullptr;
   934	
   935	    auto* db = cached->dataBuffer();
   936	    bool invalid = (db == nullptr) || db->isClosed() || !db->isValid();
   937	#ifdef SD_CUDA
   938	    if (!invalid && db != nullptr && db->special() == nullptr && !cached->isEmpty()) {
   939	      invalid = true;
   940	    }
   941	#else
   942	    if (!invalid && db != nullptr && db->primary() == nullptr && !cached->isEmpty()) {
   943	      invalid = true;
   944	    }
   945	#endif
   946	
   947	    if (!invalid) return cached;
   948	
   949	    DSP_DIAG_SLOT(MEMORY, stepIdx,
   950	        "STALE_CACHED_OUTPUT: slot %d (%s) tag=%s arr=%p db=%p valid=%d closed=%d len=%lld",
   951	        slotIdx, slot.ident.opName.c_str(), tag, (void*)cached, (void*)db,
   952	        db != nullptr && db->isValid() ? 1 : 0,
   953	        db != nullptr && db->isClosed() ? 1 : 0,
   954	        (long long)cached->lengthOf());
   955	    discardCachedSlotArray(slotIdx, cached, tag);
   956	    return nullptr;
   957	  };
   958	
   959	  // ── Fast path: identity ops ──────────────────────────────────────────────
   960	  if (slot.flags.isIdentityOp && slot.wiring.numInputs == 1 && slot.wiring.numOutputs >= 1) {
   961	    int srcIdx = slot.wiring.inputSourceIndices[0];
   962	    NDArray* input = nullptr;
   963	    if (srcIdx >= 0) {
   964	      input = outputSlots_[srcIdx];
   965	    } else {
   966	      int extIdx = -(srcIdx + 1);
   967	      if (extIdx < numExt) input = externalArrays[extIdx];
   968	    }
   969	    if (input != nullptr) {
   970	      for (int i = 0; i < slot.wiring.numOutputs; i++) {
   971	        int si = slot.wiring.outputSlotIndices[i];
   972	        if (si >= 0 && si < totalOutputSlots_) {
   973	          writeOutputSlot(si, input, "identity-alias");  // expected: alias, not new allocation
   974	        }
   975	      }
   976	#ifdef SD_CUDA
   977	      if (Environment::getInstance().tritonVerifyKernels()) {
   978	        dspLogSlotOutput(stepIdx, slot.ident.opName.c_str(), "IDENTITY",
   979	                            outputSlots_, slot.wiring.outputSlotIndices, slot.wiring.numOutputs, totalOutputSlots_);
   980	      }
   981	#endif
   982	      backfillCachedOutputShapes(slot, outputSlots_, totalOutputSlots_);
   983	      return Status::OK;
   984	    }
   985	  }
   986	
   987	  // ── Frozen constant optimization ──────────────────────────────────────────
   988	  // Only skip when shapesFrozen_ && executeCount_ > 0, because that's when
   989	  // outputSlots_ is populated from slotArrayCache_ (line 921-922).  When
   990	  // shapesFrozen_=false, outputSlots_ is zeroed — skipping a slot would
   991	  // leave a NULL entry and downstream slots would get NULL inputs.
   992	  if (slot.frozenConstantSlot() && shapesFrozen_ && executeCount_ > 0) {
   993	    // Verify all outputs are populated before skipping. If outputSlots_[si]
   994	    // is null (first execution), fall through to execute the slot so
   995	    // downstream consumers get a valid array.
   996	    bool allOutputsPopulated = true;
   997	    for (int o = 0; o < slot.wiring.numOutputs; o++) {
   998	      int si = slot.wiring.outputSlotIndices[o];
   999	      if (si >= 0 && si < totalOutputSlots_ && outputSlots_[si] == nullptr) {
  1000	        allOutputsPopulated = false;
  1001	        break;
  1002	      }
  1003	    }
  1004	    if (allOutputsPopulated) {
  1005	#ifdef SD_CUDA
  1006	      if (Environment::getInstance().tritonVerifyKernels()) {
  1007	        DSP_DIAG(VERIFY, "SLOT_EXEC step=%d op=%s [SKIPPED:frozen-const]", stepIdx, slot.ident.opName.c_str());
  1008	      }
  1009	#endif
  1010	      backfillCachedOutputShapes(slot, outputSlots_, totalOutputSlots_);
  1011	      return Status::OK;
  1012	    }
  1013	    // Fall through to execute — output slot is null, must re-execute to populate it
  1014	    DSP_DIAG(EXECUTE, "SLOT_EXEC step=%d op=%s frozen-const but output null, re-executing",
  1015	             stepIdx, slot.ident.opName.c_str());
  1016	  }
  1017	
  1018	  // ── Fused chain tail skip ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  1019	  if (slot.fusedChain.isFusedChainTail) {
  1020	#ifdef SD_CUDA
  1021	    if (Environment::getInstance().tritonVerifyKernels()) {
  1022	      DSP_DIAG(VERIFY, "SLOT_EXEC step=%d op=%s [SKIPPED:fused-tail]", stepIdx, slot.ident.opName.c_str());
  1023	    }
  1024	#endif
  1025	    return Status::OK;
  1026	  }
  1027	
  1028	  // ── Fused chain head dispatch ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  1029	  if (slot.fusedChain.isFusedChainHead && slot.fusedChain.fusedChainLength >= 2) {
  1030	    // 1. Gather primary input (head slot's first input)
  1031	    NDArray* primaryInput = nullptr;
  1032	    int primarySrcIdx = slot.wiring.inputSourceIndices[0];
  1033	    if (primarySrcIdx >= 0) {
  1034	      primaryInput = outputSlots_[primarySrcIdx];
  1035	      // Phase 2: slotArrayCache_ == outputSlots_ (unified), no separate restore needed
  1036	    } else {
  1037	      int extIdx = -(primarySrcIdx + 1);
  1038	      if (extIdx < numExt) primaryInput = externalArrays[extIdx];
  1039	    }
  1040	    if (primaryInput == nullptr) {

    62	/**
    63	 * Backfill cachedOutputShapes from the actual output arrays in outputSlots_.
    64	 * Identity ops, view ops, and frozen constant paths may skip shape inference,
    65	 * leaving cachedOutputShapes empty. Cross-segment Triton compilation needs
    66	 * these shapes, so we backfill from the live output arrays after execution.
    67	 */
    68	static void backfillCachedOutputShapes(NativeSlot& slot, NDArray** outputSlots, int totalOutputSlots) {
    69	  if (!slot.shapeCache.cachedOutputShapes.empty()) return;  // already populated
    70	  if (slot.wiring.numOutputs <= 0) return;
    71	
    72	  for (int o = 0; o < slot.wiring.numOutputs; o++) {
    73	    int si = slot.wiring.outputSlotIndices[o];
    74	    if (si >= 0 && si < totalOutputSlots && outputSlots[si] != nullptr) {
    75	      auto* outArr = outputSlots[si];
    76	      if (outArr->shapeInfo() != nullptr) {
    77	        auto cached = ConstantShapeHelper::getInstance().createFromExisting(
    78	            const_cast<LongType*>(outArr->shapeInfo()));
    79	        slot.shapeCache.cachedOutputShapes.push_back(cached);
    80	      }
    81	    }
    82	  }
    83	  if (!slot.shapeCache.cachedOutputShapes.empty() && slot.state_ < NativeSlot::SlotState::SHAPE_CACHED) {
    84	    slot.state_ = NativeSlot::SlotState::SHAPE_CACHED;
    85	  }
    86	}

   103	static bool isSmallIntegralControlArray(const NDArray* arr) {
   104	  if (arr == nullptr) return false;
   105	  const auto dt = arr->dataType();
   106	  if (dt != INT32 && dt != INT64 && dt != BOOL) return false;
   107	  const auto len = arr->lengthOf();
   108	  return len > 0 && len <= 32;
   109	}
   110	
   111	static SD_INLINE bool shouldPreserveWarmupOutputsDuringCapture() {
   112	  // Capture records GPU work against the warmup-established state; it must not
   113	  // mutate the current step's live output buffers. If we nullify reused outputs
   114	  // during capture, the zeroes stay resident because the recorded kernels/H2D
   115	  // nodes do not execute until replay on a later step.
   116	  return tl_graphExecutionActive;
   117	}
   118	
   119	static void traceSmallControlSlotIO(const char* stage,
   120	                                    int stepIdx,
   121	                                    const NativeSlot& slot,
   122	                                    const NDArray* input0,
   123	                                    const NDArray* output0,
   124	                                    int executeCount,
   125	                                    PlanPhase planPhase) {
   126	  if (!DSP_DIAG_ENABLED(SHAPE)) return;
   127	  if (!slot.flags.outputShapeDependsOnInputValues) return;
   128	  if (!isSmallIntegralControlArray(input0) && !isSmallIntegralControlArray(output0)) return;
   129	
   130	  const bool sharesBuffer =
   131	      input0 != nullptr && output0 != nullptr &&
   132	      input0->dataBuffer() != nullptr &&
   133	      input0->dataBuffer() == output0->dataBuffer();
   134	
   135	  DSP_DIAG(SHAPE,
   136	           "CONTROL_SLOT_IO: stage=%s slot=%d (%s) state=%d exec=%d phase=%d "
   137	           "input0=%s inputShape=%s output0=%s outputShape=%s sharesBuffer=%d",
   138	           stage, stepIdx, slot.ident.opName.c_str(), static_cast<int>(slot.state_),
   139	           executeCount, static_cast<int>(planPhase),
   140	           input0 != nullptr ? dspDumpHostDeviceValues(const_cast<NDArray*>(input0), 16).c_str() : "null",
   141	           input0 != nullptr ? dspShapeStr(const_cast<NDArray*>(input0)).c_str() : "null",
   142	           output0 != nullptr ? dspDumpHostDeviceValues(const_cast<NDArray*>(output0), 16).c_str() : "null",
   143	           output0 != nullptr ? dspShapeStr(const_cast<NDArray*>(output0)).c_str() : "null",
   144	           sharesBuffer ? 1 : 0);
   145	}
   146	
   147	static void traceSmallControlSlotTensors(const char* stage,
   148	                                         int stepIdx,
   149	                                         const NativeSlot& slot,
   150	                                         NDArray** inputs,
   151	                                         int numInputs,
   152	                                         NDArray** outputs,
   153	                                         int numOutputs,
   154	                                         int executeCount,
   155	                                         PlanPhase planPhase) {
   156	  if (!DSP_DIAG_ENABLED(SHAPE)) return;
   157	  if (!slot.flags.outputShapeDependsOnInputValues) return;
   158	
   159	  bool anySmallTensor = false;
   160	  std::string inputStr;
   161	  for (int i = 0; i < numInputs; i++) {
   162	    NDArray* arr = (inputs != nullptr && i < numInputs) ? inputs[i] : nullptr;
   163	    if (!isSmallIntegralControlArray(arr)) continue;
   164	    anySmallTensor = true;
   165	    if (!inputStr.empty()) inputStr += " | ";
   166	    inputStr += "input[";
   167	    inputStr += std::to_string(i);
   168	    inputStr += "]=";
   169	    inputStr += dspDumpHostDeviceValues(arr, 16);
   170	    inputStr += " shape=";
   171	    inputStr += dspShapeStr(arr);
   172	  }
   173	
   174	  std::string outputStr;
   175	  for (int i = 0; i < numOutputs; i++) {
   176	    NDArray* arr = (outputs != nullptr && i < numOutputs) ? outputs[i] : nullptr;
   177	    if (!isSmallIntegralControlArray(arr)) continue;
   178	    anySmallTensor = true;
   179	    if (!outputStr.empty()) outputStr += " | ";
   180	    outputStr += "output[";
   181	    outputStr += std::to_string(i);
   182	    outputStr += "]=";
   183	    outputStr += dspDumpHostDeviceValues(arr, 16);
   184	    outputStr += " shape=";
   185	    outputStr += dspShapeStr(arr);
   186	  }
   187	
   188	  if (!anySmallTensor) return;
   189	
   190	  DSP_DIAG(SHAPE,
   191	           "CONTROL_SLOT_TENSORS: stage=%s slot=%d (%s) state=%d exec=%d phase=%d inputs=[%s] outputs=[%s]",
   192	           stage, stepIdx, slot.ident.opName.c_str(), static_cast<int>(slot.state_),
   193	           executeCount, static_cast<int>(planPhase),
   194	           inputStr.empty() ? "none" : inputStr.c_str(),
   195	           outputStr.empty() ? "none" : outputStr.c_str());
   196	}
   197	
   198	static void reconcileExecutedOutputActuality(const char* stage,
   199	                                             int stepIdx,
   200	                                             const NativeSlot& slot,
   201	                                             NDArray* output) {
   202	  if (output == nullptr) return;
   203	  auto* db = output->dataBuffer();
   204	  if (db == nullptr || db->isClosed()) return;
   205	
   206	#ifdef SD_CUDA
   207	  const bool primaryActual = db->isPrimaryActual();
   208	  const bool specialActual = db->isSpecialActual();
   209	  const bool needsDeviceVisibleControl =
   210	      slot.flags.isDataDependent || slot.flags.outputShapeDependsOnInputValues ||
   211	      isSmallIntegralControlArray(output);
   212	
   213	  if (primaryActual && !specialActual) {
   214	    if (needsDeviceVisibleControl) {
   215	      output->syncToDevice();
   216	      DSP_DIAG(SHAPE,
   217	               "CONTROL_OUTPUT_SYNC: stage=%s slot=%d (%s) "
   218	               "synced host-current output to device after native execution",
   219	               stage, stepIdx, slot.ident.opName.c_str());
   220	    }
   221	    return;
   222	  }
   223	
   224	  if (!primaryActual && !specialActual) {
   225	    db->writeSpecial();
   226	    DSP_DIAG(EXECUTE,
   227	             "OUTPUT_ACTUALITY_REPAIR: stage=%s slot=%d (%s) "
   228	             "marked device current after untracked native write",
   229	             stage, stepIdx, slot.ident.opName.c_str());
   230	  }
   231	#else
   232	  (void)stage;
   233	  (void)stepIdx;
   234	  (void)slot;
   235	#endif
   236	}

   238	static bool slotHasOnlyPlanInternalControlInputs(const NativeSlot& slot,
   239	                                                 NDArray** outputSlots,
   240	                                                 int totalOutputSlots,
   241	                                                 NDArray** externalArrays,
   242	                                                 int numExt) {
   243	  bool sawControlInput = false;
   244	  for (int i = 0; i < slot.wiring.numInputs; i++) {
   245	    NDArray* arr = resolveInputSourceArray(slot.wiring.inputSourceIndices[i], outputSlots,
   246	                                           totalOutputSlots, externalArrays, numExt);
   247	    if (!isSmallIntegralControlArray(arr)) continue;
   248	    sawControlInput = true;
   249	    if (slot.wiring.inputSourceIndices[i] < 0) {
   250	      return false;
   251	    }
   252	  }
   253	  return sawControlInput;
   254	}
   255	
   256	static bool hasPlanInternalValueShapeAncestor(int stepIdx,
   257	                                              const NativeSlot* slots,
   258	                                              int numSlots,
   259	                                              NDArray** outputSlots,
   260	                                              int totalOutputSlots,
   261	                                              NDArray** externalArrays,
   262	                                              int numExt,
   263	                                              std::unordered_set<int>& visitedSteps) {
   264	  if (slots == nullptr || stepIdx < 0 || stepIdx >= numSlots) return false;
   265	  if (!visitedSteps.insert(stepIdx).second) return false;
   266	
   267	  const auto& slot = slots[stepIdx];
   268	  if (slot.flags.outputShapeDependsOnInputValues &&
   269	      slotHasOnlyPlanInternalControlInputs(slot, outputSlots, totalOutputSlots,
   270	                                           externalArrays, numExt)) {
   271	    return true;
   272	  }
   273	
   274	  for (int i = 0; i < slot.wiring.numInputs; i++) {
   275	    const int srcIdx = slot.wiring.inputSourceIndices[i];
   276	    if (srcIdx < 0) continue;
   277	    const int producerStep = findProducingStepForOutputSlot(slots, numSlots, srcIdx);
   278	    if (producerStep >= 0 &&
   279	        hasPlanInternalValueShapeAncestor(producerStep, slots, numSlots,
   280	                                          outputSlots, totalOutputSlots,
   281	                                          externalArrays, numExt, visitedSteps)) {
   282	      return true;
   283	    }
   284	  }
   285	
   286	  return false;
   287	}
   288	
   289	static bool allowFrozenShapeRestabilization(int stepIdx,
   290	                                            const NativeSlot& slot,
   291	                                            PlanPhase planPhase,
   292	                                            const NativeSlot* slots,
   293	                                            int numSlots,
   294	                                            NDArray** outputSlots,
   295	                                            int totalOutputSlots,
   296	                                            NDArray** externalArrays,
   297	                                            int numExt) {
   298	  if (planPhase >= PlanPhase::POINTERS_STABLE) return false;
   299	
   300	  if (slot.flags.outputShapeDependsOnInputValues &&
   301	      slotHasOnlyPlanInternalControlInputs(slot, outputSlots, totalOutputSlots,
   302	                                           externalArrays, numExt)) {
   303	    return true;
   304	  }
   305	
   306	  std::unordered_set<int> visitedSteps;
   307	  for (int i = 0; i < slot.wiring.numInputs; i++) {
   308	    const int srcIdx = slot.wiring.inputSourceIndices[i];
   309	    if (srcIdx < 0) continue;
   310	    const int producerStep = findProducingStepForOutputSlot(slots, numSlots, srcIdx);
   311	    if (producerStep >= 0 &&
   312	        hasPlanInternalValueShapeAncestor(producerStep, slots, numSlots,
   313	                                          outputSlots, totalOutputSlots,
   314	                                          externalArrays, numExt, visitedSteps)) {
   315	      return true;
   316	    }
   317	  }
   318	
   319	  return false;
   320	}

   322	static void appendUpstreamControlTrace(std::string& out,
   323	                                       int srcIdx,
   324	                                       int depth,
   325	                                       const NativeSlot* slots,
   326	                                       int numSlots,
   327	                                       NDArray** outputSlots,
   328	                                       int totalOutputSlots,
   329	                                       NDArray** externalArrays,
   330	                                       int numExt,
   331	                                       const std::vector<std::string>& externalInputNames,
   332	                                       std::vector<int>& seenSlotSteps) {
   333	  if (depth < 0) return;
   334	
   335	  if (srcIdx < 0) {
   336	    const int extIdx = -(srcIdx + 1);
   337	    out += "ext[";
   338	    out += std::to_string(extIdx);
   339	    out += "]";
   340	    if (extIdx >= 0 && extIdx < numExt) {
   341	      if (extIdx < static_cast<int>(externalInputNames.size()) &&
   342	          !externalInputNames[extIdx].empty()) {
   343	        out += "=\"";
   344	        out += externalInputNames[extIdx];
   345	        out += "\"";
   346	      }
   347	      NDArray* ext = externalArrays != nullptr ? externalArrays[extIdx] : nullptr;
   348	      out += " ";
   349	      out += ext != nullptr ? dspDumpHostDeviceValues(ext, 8) : "null";
   350	      if (ext != nullptr) {
   351	        out += " shape=";
   352	        out += dspShapeStr(ext);
   353	      }
   354	    } else {
   355	      out += " OUT_OF_RANGE";
   356	    }
   357	    return;
   358	  }
   359	
   360	  const int producerStep = findProducingStepForOutputSlot(slots, numSlots, srcIdx);
   361	  out += "slot[";
   362	  out += std::to_string(srcIdx);
   363	  out += "]";
   364	  if (producerStep >= 0) {
   365	    out += " step=";
   366	    out += std::to_string(producerStep);
   367	    out += " op=";
   368	    out += slots[producerStep].ident.opName;
   369	  }
   370	
   371	  NDArray* arr = (outputSlots != nullptr && srcIdx < totalOutputSlots) ? outputSlots[srcIdx] : nullptr;
   372	  out += " ";
   373	  out += arr != nullptr ? dspDumpHostDeviceValues(arr, 8) : "null";
   374	  if (arr != nullptr) {
   375	    out += " shape=";
   376	    out += dspShapeStr(arr);
   377	  }
   378	
   379	  if (producerStep < 0 || depth == 0) return;
   380	  if (std::find(seenSlotSteps.begin(), seenSlotSteps.end(), producerStep) != seenSlotSteps.end()) {
   381	    out += " <cycle>";
   382	    return;
   383	  }
   384	
   385	  seenSlotSteps.push_back(producerStep);
   386	  const auto& producer = slots[producerStep];
   387	  if (producer.wiring.numInputs > 0) {
   388	    out += " <= {";
   389	    for (int i = 0; i < producer.wiring.numInputs; i++) {
   390	      if (i > 0) out += "; ";
   391	      appendUpstreamControlTrace(out, producer.wiring.inputSourceIndices[i], depth - 1,
   392	                                 slots, numSlots, outputSlots, totalOutputSlots,
   393	                                 externalArrays, numExt, externalInputNames,
   394	                                 seenSlotSteps);
   395	    }
   396	    out += "}";
   397	  }
   398	  seenSlotSteps.pop_back();
   399	}

   401	/**
   402	 * Build shape info for a permute view: delegates to ShapeUtils::evalPermutedViewShapeInfo.
   403	 * Unlike calculateOutputShape (which sets contiguous strides), the ShapeUtils function
   404	 * preserves the input's actual stride pattern so the view reads data correctly.
   405	 *
   406	 * Returns a ConstantShapeHelper-managed pointer (not owned by caller).
   407	 */
   408	static const LongType* buildPermutedViewShapeInfo(const NDArray* input, const NativeSlot& slot) {
   409	  // Build the permutation array from iArgs
   410	  std::vector<int> permVec;
   411	  if (slot.args.numIArgs > 0) {
   412	    for (int i = 0; i < slot.args.numIArgs; i++) permVec.push_back(static_cast<int>(slot.args.iArgs[i]));
   413	  } else {
   414	    return nullptr;
   415	  }
   416	
   417	  return ShapeUtils::evalPermutedViewShapeInfo(input, permVec.data(), static_cast<int>(permVec.size()));
   418	}

   391	   *   SHAPE_CACHED → COMPILED:        Segment compiled/captured

   402	    SHAPE_CACHED,     // Shape cache populated, view status determined
   403	    COMPILED,         // Segment compiled/captured

   614	     * Configure KV cache retention in the native C++ plan.

   616	     * C++ scatters new KV entries into static input buffers internally.
   617	     *
   618	     * <p>The mapping is resolved by output variable name, not only by requested output
   619	     * index, so decode can request logits only while still retaining present KV slots.</p>
   620	     *

   623	     * @param pastInputNames     ordered list of corresponding past_key_values input names
   624	     * @param maxKvLen           static KV buffer size along sequence dimension
   625	     * @param initialPos         initial cache position (prefillLen)
   626	     * @return true if retention was configured successfully
   627	     */
   628	    public boolean configureKvCacheRetention(DynamicShapePlan plan,

   632	        if (nativePlanHandle == null || nativePlanHandle.isNull()) {
   633	            log.warn("configureKvCacheRetention: native plan not yet compiled, skipping");
   634	            return false;
   635	        }
   636	        if (presentOutputNames.size() != pastInputNames.size()) {
   637	            throw new IllegalArgumentException("presentOutputNames and pastInputNames must have the same size");

   640	        String[] extKeys = plan.getExternalInputKeys();

   286	
   287	void NativeDynamicShapePlan::platformPreExecuteSetup(
   288	    NDArray** externalInputs, int numExternalInputs, void* stream) {
   289	
   290	  // Clear stale CUDA errors
   291	  cudaGetLastError();
   292	
   293	  // Clear attention workspace when no graphs are cached yet.
   294	  {
   295	    bool anyGraphCached = false;
   296	    for (const auto& seg : segments_) {
   297	      if (seg.exec.replayHandle != nullptr && seg.exec.replayHandle->isReady()) { anyGraphCached = true; break; }

   308	  if (!shapesFrozen_ || executeCount_ == 0) {
   309	    for (auto& segment : segments_) {
   310	      if (segment.exec.replayHandle) {
   311	        LongType segShapeKey = computeSegmentShapeKey(segment, externalInputs, numExternalInputs);
   312	        if (segment.exec.cachedShapeKey != segShapeKey) {
   313	          platformCleanupSegmentForRebuild(segment);
   314	        }
   315	      }
   316	    }
   317	  }
   318	}
