   321	// Platform dispatch: Segment cache retention check
   322	// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   323	
   324	bool NativeDynamicShapePlan::platformShouldKeepSegmentCache(const GraphSegment& seg) const {
   325	  // Keep caches for segments with an instantiated graph that can replay.
   326	  // Check ONLY for replay handle — NOT compilationFailed. The compilationFailed flag means
   327	  // the Triton path failed, but the CUDA graph fallback may have succeeded and set
   328	  // replayHandle. During cleanup between calls, compilationFailed is still true (Fix 10
   329	  // clears it during the NEXT execution). If we also require !compilationFailed, cleanup
   330	  // frees the segment's slots → graph replay D2D copies read freed memory → NaN.
   331	  if (seg.exec.replayHandle != nullptr) return true;
   332	  return false;
   333	}

    37	/**
    38	 * Static (dense) KV cache manager for CUDA graph-compatible decode.
    39	 *
    40	 * <p>Pre-allocates dense [batch, heads, maxKvLen, headDim] buffers at prefill time
    41	 * and uses the native {@code kv_scatter} op (via {@link DecoderUtils#scatterNewKvEntries})
    42	 * to write new entries at each decode step. The buffers have fixed shapes after
    43	 * initialization, enabling CUDA graph capture and replay.</p>
    44	 *
    45	 * <h3>Scatter modes</h3>
    46	 * <ul>
    47	 *   <li><b>Java scatter</b> (default): Decoder outputs present KV tensors, Java calls
    48	 *       the batched KvScatter op to copy entries into static buffers.</li>
    49	 *   <li><b>C++ scatter</b>: When DSP's {@code configureKvCacheRetention} succeeds,
    50	 *       the native plan handles KV scatter internally and only outputs logits.
    51	 *       Controlled via the {@code kvScatterInCpp} flag.</li>
    52	 * </ul>
    53	 *
    54	 * <h3>Input modes</h3>
    55	 * <ul>
    56	 *   <li><b>Padded mode</b> (DSP active): Full static buffer passed as input with
    57	 *       sparse attention mask. Fixed shapes for CUDA graphs.</li>
    58	 *   <li><b>View mode</b> (no DSP): KV views [0:cachePos] passed as input with
    59	 *       all-ones attention mask. Growing shapes, no CUDA graph support.</li>
    60	 * </ul>
    61	 *
    62	 * @see KvCacheManager
    63	 * @see DecoderUtils#padKvCacheToStaticSize
    64	 * @see DecoderUtils#scatterNewKvEntries

    68	
    69	    @Getter

    71

    78	    private boolean initialized;

   136	        List<String> pastInputNames = new ArrayList<>();

   161	    @Override
   162	    public void prepareInputs(Map<String, INDArray> decoderInputMap, SameDiff decoder,

   166	        for (String inputName : decoder.inputs()) {

   179	                                NDArrayIndex.interval(0, cachePosition), NDArrayIndex.all());

   184	                        decoderInputMap.put(inputName,
   185	                                DecoderUtils.createEmptyKvCache(decoder, inputName, 1, hiddenSize));

   188	            } else {

   192	        }

   195	    @Override

   210	    @Override
   211	    public void scatterMultipleEntries(Map<String, INDArray> decoderOutputs,

   213	                                       int numEntries) {
   214	        if (numEntries <= 0) return;

   216	        DecoderUtils.scatterMultipleKvEntries(staticKvBuffers, decoderOutputs,
   217	                kvNames.keyNames, kvNames.valueNames, maxKvLen, cachePosition, numEntries);

   219	    }

commit 47a24d3ce434e02a93cbf21f0c11b7aeb1cf70ba
Author: agibsonccc <adam@konduit.ai>
Date:   Sun Apr 12 05:24:16 2026 +0900

    fix: GPU memory leak — tl_castCache unbounded growth (250 MB/step)
    
    Root cause: MmulHelper.cu's tl_castCacheA/B.push_back() grew unboundedly
    during non-capture matmul execution. Each FP32→HALF cast created a
    persistent NDArray copy pushed to the thread-local cache every step.
    resetCastCacheIndices() only reset the INDEX (to 0) not the cache,
    so the cache grew by ~1.2 MB per matmul × 211 matmuls = ~250 MB/step.
    nvidia-smi confirmed: 250 MB/step before fix, 0 MB/step after.
    
    Leaks fixed:
    - tl_castCacheA/B.push_back in mmulMxM (FP32×FP32→HALF TF32 path)
    - tl_castCacheA.push_back in mmulMxM (FLOAT32×HALF mixed-type path)
    - tl_castCacheB.push_back in mmulMxM (HALF×FLOAT32 mixed-type path)
    - tl_castCacheA/B.push_back in mmulMxV (FP32→HALF vector path)
    
    Other changes:
    - CudaGraphHandle: enable AutoFreeOnLaunch by default
    - CudaExecutioner: delegate selectTargetDevice to DeviceMemoryManager
    - InferenceSession: close cast placeholder copies after DSP execution,
      add DSP_DIAG-based memory diagnostics in writeOutputSlot
    - StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop: per-phase GPU memory tracking
    - BenchmarkConfigApplier: trim pools after resetModelState
    - TestDspValidation: memory leak isolation tests
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

+  // from outputSlots_[], causing ~240 MB/step GPU memory leak in large models.
+  if (old != nullptr && old != value) {
+    bool isPlanOwned = planOwnedArrays_.count(old) > 0;
+    if (isPlanOwned) {
+      auto* oldDb = old->dataBuffer();
+      bool isProtected = oldDb != nullptr && protectedWeightBuffers_.count(oldDb) > 0;
+      if (!isProtected) {
+        // Check that no OTHER slot still references this exact NDArray pointer.
+        // View ops can share the same NDArray across slots.
+        bool referencedElsewhere = false;
+        for (int i = 0; i < totalOutputSlots_; i++) {
+          if (i != slotIdx && outputSlots_[i] == old) {
+            referencedElsewhere = true;

+        if (!referencedElsewhere) {

+          delete old;

+      long long leakedBytes = old->dataBuffer() ? (long long)old->dataBuffer()->getLenInBytes() : 0;

-void NativeDynamicShapePlan::clearShapeCaches() {

+void NativeDynamicShapePlan::advancePlanPhase() {
+  // ── Plan-level phase advancement ───────────────────────────────────────────
+  // Phase transitions are automatic based on observed stability:
+  //   SHAPES_FROZEN → POINTERS_STABLE: after 2+ frozen executions with every
+  //                                     replay-eligible segment in pointer-stable state
+  //   POINTERS_STABLE → REPLAYING:     when every replay-eligible segment reaches
+  //                                     backend-specific replay steady state
+  //
+  // Caller is responsible for: incrementing frozenExecutionCount_, capturing
+  // frozenSnapshot_ on first frozen execution.
+  if (!shapesFrozen_ || planPhase_ < PlanPhase::SHAPES_FROZEN) return;
+
+  // Check pointer stability across all replay-eligible segments.
+  if (planPhase_ == PlanPhase::SHAPES_FROZEN && frozenExecutionCount_ >= 2) {
+    bool allStable = true;
+    for (auto& seg : segments_) {
+      if (!segmentHasStablePointersForPlanPhase(seg, slots_)) {
+        allStable = false;
+        break;
+      }
+    }
+    if (allStable) {
+      pointersStable_ = true;
+      const char* oldPhase = dsp::planPhaseName(planPhase_);
+      planPhase_ = PlanPhase::POINTERS_STABLE;
+      DSP_DIAG(EXECUTE, "PLAN_PHASE: %s → POINTERS_STABLE (frozenExec=%d)",
+               oldPhase, frozenExecutionCount_);
+    }
+  }
+
+  // Promote to REPLAYING only once every replay-eligible segment has reached
+  // steady-state replay. Mixed-phase plans stay at POINTERS_STABLE.
+  if (planPhase_ >= PlanPhase::POINTERS_STABLE) {
+    bool hasReplayEligibleSegment = false;
+    bool allReplaying = true;
+    for (auto& seg : segments_) {
+      if (!segmentBlocksPlanPhase(seg)) continue;
+      hasReplayEligibleSegment = true;
+      if (!segmentIsFullyReplayingForPlanPhase(seg, slots_)) {
+        allReplaying = false;
+        break;
+      }
+    }
+    if (hasReplayEligibleSegment && allReplaying && planPhase_ != PlanPhase::REPLAYING) {
+      const char* oldPhase = dsp::planPhaseName(planPhase_);
+      planPhase_ = PlanPhase::REPLAYING;
+      DSP_DIAG(EXECUTE, "PLAN_PHASE: %s → REPLAYING (frozenExec=%d)",
+               oldPhase, frozenExecutionCount_);
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+void NativeDynamicShapePlan::demotePlanPhase(PlanPhase targetPhase, const char* reason) {
+  const char* oldPhase = dsp::planPhaseName(planPhase_);
+  const char* newPhase = dsp::planPhaseName(targetPhase);
+  DSP_DIAG(FALLBACK, "PHASE_DEMOTION: %s → %s: %s (frozenExec=%d)",
+           oldPhase, newPhase, reason, frozenExecutionCount_);
+  planPhase_ = targetPhase;
+  if (targetPhase < PlanPhase::POINTERS_STABLE) {
+    pointersStable_ = false;
+  }
+}
+
+Status NativeDynamicShapePlan::phaseFreeze() {
+  auto& env = Environment::getInstance();
+  bool mergeSegments = env.dspFreezeMergeSegments();
+
+  // ── Fusion pass (slot-by-slot → freeze transition) ──────────────────
+  if (numSlots_ > 1) {
+    auto fusions = FusionPass::detectFusions(slots_, numSlots_, externalInputRanks_);
+    if (!fusions.empty()) {
+      DSP_DIAG(FUSION, "detected %d fusion candidates (post-warmup)",
+               (int)fusions.size());
+      int applied = FusionPass::applyFusions(slots_, numSlots_, fusions);
+      DSP_DIAG(FUSION, "applied %d of %d fusion candidates",
+               applied, (int)fusions.size());
+    }
+  }
+
+  DSP_DIAG(SEGMENT, "SEGMENT_MAP: %d segments (frozen first exec)", (int)segments_.size());
+  for (int i = 0; i < (int)segments_.size(); i++) {
+    auto& s = segments_[i];
+    DSP_DIAG(SEGMENT, "  seg[%d]: slots[%d-%d] capturable=%d hasReplay=%d "
+             "compilationFailed=%d execCount=%d",
+             i, s.def.startSlot, s.def.endSlot, s.def.isCapturable,
+             s.exec.replayHandle != nullptr, s.exec.compilationFailed, s.exec.executionCount);
+  }
+
+  planPhase_ = PlanPhase::SHAPES_FROZEN;
+  pointersStable_ = false;
+  frozenExecutionCount_ = 0;
+
+  DSP_DIAG(EXECUTE, "FROZEN_TRANSITION: unfrozen → FROZEN, "
+            "%d segments, %d slots, %d extInputs, mergeSegments=%d, recompile=%d",
+            (int)segments_.size(), numSlots_, numExternalInputs_,
+            mergeSegments ? 1 : 0, env.dspFreezeRecompile() ? 1 : 0);
+
+  MmulHelper::clearCastCache();
+
+  executeCount_ = 0;
+  for (auto& seg : segments_) {
+    seg.exec.executionCount = 0;
+    if (seg.exec.replayHandle) {
+      platformCleanupSegmentForRebuild(seg);
+    }
+    seg.exec.argTableStable = false;
+    seg.exec.gapOpsCapturedInGraph = false;
+    seg.exec.cachedShapeKey = 0;
+    seg.exec.capturedInputAddrKey = 0;
+    seg.exec.capturedCreateValueKey = 0;
+    seg.exec.compilationFailed = false;
+    seg.exec.currentPhase = ExecutionPhase::WARMUP;
+  }
+
+  for (auto* db : protectedWeightBuffers_) {
+    if (db != nullptr) db->addFrozenRef();
+  }
+
+  if (outputSlots_ != nullptr) {
+    for (int i = 0; i < totalOutputSlots_; i++) {
+      if (outputSlots_[i] != nullptr && outputSlots_[i]->dataBuffer() != nullptr) {
+        outputSlots_[i]->dataBuffer()->addFrozenRef();
+      }
+    }
+    DSP_DIAG(MEMORY, "phaseFreeze: added frozen ref to %d output slot DataBuffers", totalOutputSlots_);
+  }
+
+  return Status::OK;
+}
+
+Status NativeDynamicShapePlan::phaseWarmup(NDArray** externalInputs, int numExternalInputs,
+                                           void* stream, PhaseExecutionStats* stats) {
+  DSP_DIAG(EXECUTE, "phaseWarmup: BEGIN segments=%d extInputs=%d", (int)segments_.size(), numExternalInputs);
+
+  long long slotBySlotUs = 0;
+  int slotBySlotSegs = 0;
+  int slotBySlotSlots = 0;
+  using Clock = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock;
+
+  // Reset segment state for warmup
+  for (auto& segment : segments_) {
+    segment.exec.executionCount = 0;
+    segment.exec.compilationFailed = false;
+    segment.exec.captureOomRetries = 0;
+    segment.exec.captureRetryAfterExec = 0;
+    segment.exec.cachedShapeKey = 0;
+    segment.exec.capturedInputAddrKey = 0;
+    segment.exec.capturedCreateValueKey = 0;
+    segment.exec.gapOpsCapturedInGraph = false;
+    if (segment.exec.replayHandle) {
+      platformCleanupSegmentForRebuild(segment);
+    }
+  }
+
+  platformClearCastCache();
+
+  // Execute all segments slot-by-slot to populate shapes
+  int segIdx = 0;
+  for (auto& segment : segments_) {
+    DSP_DIAG(EXECUTE, "phaseWarmup: seg[%d] slots=[%d-%d] capturable=%d starting...",
+             segIdx, segment.def.startSlot, segment.def.endSlot,
+             static_cast<int>(segment.def.isCapturable));
+    if (!platformBindSegmentDevice(segment)) {
+      return Status::KERNEL_FAILURE;
+    }
+    platformMigrateSegmentInputs(segment, externalInputs, numExternalInputs);
+
+    segment.exec.currentPhase = segment.def.isCapturable
+        ? ExecutionPhase::WARMUP
+        : ExecutionPhase::SLOT_BY_SLOT;
+
+    auto tSegStart = executionTimingEnabled_ ? Clock::now() : Clock::time_point{};
+    auto status = executeSegmentSlotBySlot(segment, externalInputs, numExternalInputs, stream);
+    DSP_DIAG(EXECUTE, "phaseWarmup: seg[%d] slots=[%d-%d] completed status=%d",
+             segIdx, segment.def.startSlot, segment.def.endSlot, static_cast<int>(status));
+    segIdx++;
+    if (status != Status::OK) return status;
+
+    // Increment executionCount so that executeSegmentWithGraph sees exec >= 1
+    // and proceeds to graph capture instead of repeating warmup.
+    segment.exec.executionCount = 1;
+
+    // Note: We intentionally do NOT call computeSegmentShapeKey here.
+    // It is extremely expensive (per-element D2H sync for small inputs) and
+    // unnecessary during warmup. executeSegmentWithGraph will compute the
+    // key when it actually needs it for graph capture.
+
+    if (executionTimingEnabled_) {
+      auto segUs = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::microseconds>(Clock::now() - tSegStart).count();
+      slotBySlotUs += segUs;
+      slotBySlotSegs++;
+      slotBySlotSlots += segment.def.endSlot - segment.def.startSlot + 1;
+    }
+
+    platformCleanupMigratedInputs();
+    auto postStatus = platformCheckPostSegment(segment);
+    if (postStatus != Status::OK) return postStatus;
+  }
+
+  if (stats != nullptr) {
+    stats->slotBySlotUs = slotBySlotUs;
+    stats->slotBySlotSegs = slotBySlotSegs;
+    stats->slotBySlotSlots = slotBySlotSlots;
+  }
+
+  return Status::OK;
+}
+
+void NativeDynamicShapePlan::phaseCompile(NDArray** externalInputs, int numExternalInputs) {
+  DSP_DIAG(COMPILE, "phaseCompile: BEGIN segments=%d extInputs=%d", (int)segments_.size(), numExternalInputs);
+  platformPrecompileSegments(externalInputs, numExternalInputs);
+  DSP_DIAG(COMPILE, "phaseCompile: END");
+}
+
+Status NativeDynamicShapePlan::phaseSlotBySlot(NDArray** externalInputs, int numExternalInputs,
+                                               void* stream, PhaseExecutionStats* stats) {
+  DSP_DIAG(EXECUTE, "phaseSlotBySlot: BEGIN segments=%d extInputs=%d", (int)segments_.size(), numExternalInputs);
+
+  long long slotBySlotUs = 0;
+  int slotBySlotSegs = 0;
+  int slotBySlotSlots = 0;
+  using Clock = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock;
+
+  for (auto& segment : segments_) {
+    if (!platformBindSegmentDevice(segment)) {
+      return Status::KERNEL_FAILURE;
+    }
+    platformMigrateSegmentInputs(segment, externalInputs, numExternalInputs);
+
+    segment.exec.currentPhase = segment.def.isCapturable
+        ? ExecutionPhase::WARMUP
+        : ExecutionPhase::SLOT_BY_SLOT;
+
+    auto tSegStart = executionTimingEnabled_ ? Clock::now() : Clock::time_point{};
+    auto status = executeSegmentSlotBySlot(segment, externalInputs, numExternalInputs, stream);
+    if (status != Status::OK) return status;
+
+    if (executionTimingEnabled_) {
+      auto segUs = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::microseconds>(Clock::now() - tSegStart).count();
+      slotBySlotUs += segUs;
+      slotBySlotSegs++;
+      slotBySlotSlots += segment.def.endSlot - segment.def.startSlot + 1;
+    }
+
+    platformCleanupMigratedInputs();
+    auto postStatus = platformCheckPostSegment(segment);
+    if (postStatus != Status::OK) return postStatus;
+  }
+
+  if (stats != nullptr) {
+    stats->slotBySlotUs = slotBySlotUs;
+    stats->slotBySlotSegs = slotBySlotSegs;
+    stats->slotBySlotSlots = slotBySlotSlots;
+  }
+
+  return Status::OK;
+}
+
+Status NativeDynamicShapePlan::phaseReplay(NDArray** externalInputs, int numExternalInputs,
+                                           NDArray** requestedOutputs, int numRequestedOutputs,
+                                           void* stream, PhaseExecutionStats* stats) {
+  DSP_DIAG(EXECUTE, "phaseReplay: BEGIN segments=%d extInputs=%d frozen=%d phase=%d execCount=%d",
+           (int)segments_.size(), numExternalInputs, shapesFrozen_ ? 1 : 0,
+           static_cast<int>(planPhase_), executeCount_);
+
+  size_t poolUsedPreSegs = 0, poolReservedPreSegs = 0;
+  platformPreReplayPoolStats(poolUsedPreSegs, poolReservedPreSegs);
+
+  long long graphReplayUs = 0, slotBySlotUs = 0;
+  int graphReplaySegs = 0, slotBySlotSegs = 0, graphReplaySlots = 0, slotBySlotSlots = 0;
+
+  using Clock = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock;
+
+  for (auto& segment : segments_) {
+    if (!platformBindSegmentDevice(segment)) {
+      return Status::KERNEL_FAILURE;
+    }
+    platformMigrateSegmentInputs(segment, externalInputs, numExternalInputs);
+
+    bool useGraph = platformShouldUseGraph(segment);
+    auto tSegStart = executionTimingEnabled_ ? Clock::now() : Clock::time_point{};
+    bool segUsedGraph = false;
+    int segSlots = segment.def.endSlot - segment.def.startSlot + 1;
+
+    if (segment.def.selectedBackend == SelectedBackend::EMULATED_REPLAY) {
+      auto status = executeSegmentEmulatedReplay(segment, externalInputs, numExternalInputs, stream);
+      if (status != Status::OK) return status;
+      segUsedGraph = true;
+    } else if (useGraph) {
+      auto status = platformExecuteSegmentWithBackends(
+          segment, externalInputs, numExternalInputs, stream, segUsedGraph);
+      if (status != Status::OK) return status;
+    } else {
+      segment.exec.currentPhase = segment.def.isCapturable
+          ? ExecutionPhase::WARMUP
+          : ExecutionPhase::SLOT_BY_SLOT;
+      auto status = executeSegmentSlotBySlot(segment, externalInputs, numExternalInputs, stream);
+      if (status != Status::OK) return status;
+    }
+
+    if (executionTimingEnabled_) {
+      auto segUs = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::microseconds>(Clock::now() - tSegStart).count();
+      if (segUsedGraph) {
+        graphReplayUs += segUs;
+        graphReplaySegs++;
+        graphReplaySlots += segSlots;
+      } else {
+        slotBySlotUs += segUs;
+        slotBySlotSegs++;
+        slotBySlotSlots += segSlots;
+      }
+    }
+
+    platformCleanupMigratedInputs();
+    auto postStatus = platformCheckPostSegment(segment);
+    if (postStatus != Status::OK) return postStatus;
+
+    // Trace slot reporting (GPU only)
+    platformTraceSlotValues(segment, stream, executeCount_);
+
+    // NaN detection (gated behind tritonVerifyKernels)
+    if (shapesFrozen_ && Environment::getInstance().tritonVerifyKernels()) {
+      for (int stepIdx = segment.def.startSlot; stepIdx <= segment.def.endSlot; stepIdx++) {
+        auto& slot = slots_[stepIdx];
+        for (int o = 0; o < slot.wiring.numOutputs; o++) {
+          int si = slot.wiring.outputSlotIndices[o];
+          if (si < 0 || si >= totalOutputSlots_ || outputSlots_[si] == nullptr) continue;
+          auto* arr = outputSlots_[si];
+          auto* db = arr->dataBuffer();
+          if (db == nullptr || DSP_BUF(arr) == nullptr || arr->lengthOf() == 0) continue;
+          bool dbClosed = db->isClosed();
+          if (dbClosed) {
+            DSP_DIAG_SLOT(VERIFY, stepIdx, slot.ident.opName.c_str(),
+                    "NaN_CLOSED_DB seg[%d-%d] outSlot=%d DataBuffer CLOSED! "
+                    "frozenConst=%d shapeStatic=%d execCount=%d",
+                    segment.def.startSlot, segment.def.endSlot, si,
+                    slot.frozenConstantSlot() ? 1 : 0, slot.shapeCache.shapeStatic ? 1 : 0, executeCount_);
+            continue;
+          }
+          arr->syncToHost();
+          bool hasNaN = arr->hasNaNs();
+          if (hasNaN) {
+            bool anyInputNaN = false;
+            for (int inp = 0; inp < slot.wiring.numInputs; inp++) {
+              int srcIdx = slot.wiring.inputSourceIndices[inp];
+              NDArray* srcArr = nullptr;
+              if (srcIdx >= 0 && srcIdx < totalOutputSlots_) {
+                srcArr = outputSlots_[srcIdx];
+              } else if (srcIdx < 0) {
+                int extIdx = -(srcIdx + 1);
+                if (extIdx >= 0 && extIdx < numExternalInputs) srcArr = externalInputs[extIdx];
+              }
+              if (srcArr != nullptr && srcArr->lengthOf() > 0) {
+                srcArr->syncToHost();
+                bool inpHasNaN = srcArr->hasNaNs();
+                if (inpHasNaN) anyInputNaN = true;
+              }
+            }
+            DSP_DIAG_SLOT(VERIFY, stepIdx, slot.ident.opName.c_str(),
+                    "NaN_DETECT seg[%d-%d] output[%d]=%d NaN! "
+                    "useGraph=%d execCount=%d len=%lld inputsNaN=%d hasReplay=%d "
+                    "frozenConst=%d shapeStatic=%d",
+                    segment.def.startSlot, segment.def.endSlot, o, si,
+                    useGraph ? 1 : 0, executeCount_, (long long)arr->lengthOf(),
+                    anyInputNaN ? 1 : 0,
+                    segment.exec.replayHandle != nullptr ? 1 : 0,
+                    slot.frozenConstantSlot() ? 1 : 0, slot.shapeCache.shapeStatic ? 1 : 0);
+            goto nanDetectDoneReplay;
+          }
+        }
+      }
+      nanDetectDoneReplay:;
+    }
+  }
+
+  // Post-segment pool trimming
+  platformPostReplayPoolManagement(poolUsedPreSegs, shapesFrozen_, executeCount_);
+
+  // Copy requested outputs
+  for (int i = 0; i < numRequestedOutputs_; i++) {
+    int slotIdx = requestedOutputSlotIndices_[i];
+    if (slotIdx >= 0 && slotIdx < totalOutputSlots_) {
+      requestedOutputs[i] = outputSlots_[slotIdx];
+    } else {
+      requestedOutputs[i] = nullptr;
+    }
+  }
+
+  // KV cache retention
+  if (kvCacheRetentionEnabled_) {
+    scatterKvEntries(externalInputs, numExternalInputs, stream);
+    kvCachePosition_++;
+  }
+
+  // Timing breakdown
+  if (executionTimingEnabled_) {
+    DSP_DIAG(TIMING, "replay: graph=%lldus(%d segs/%d slots) sbs=%lldus(%d segs/%d slots)",
+             graphReplayUs, graphReplaySegs, graphReplaySlots,
+             slotBySlotUs, slotBySlotSegs, slotBySlotSlots);
+  }
+
+  if (stats != nullptr) {
+    stats->graphReplayUs = graphReplayUs;
+    stats->slotBySlotUs = slotBySlotUs;
+    stats->graphReplaySegs = graphReplaySegs;
+    stats->slotBySlotSegs = slotBySlotSegs;
+    stats->graphReplaySlots = graphReplaySlots;
+    stats->slotBySlotSlots = slotBySlotSlots;
+  }
+
+  return Status::OK;
+}
+
+void NativeDynamicShapePlan::clearShapeCaches() {
+  // When shapes are frozen, skip clearing entirely after first execution.
+  // All cached shapes remain valid since external input shapes are constant.
+  if (shapesFrozen_ && executeCount_ > 0) return;
+
+  for (int i = 0; i < numSlots_; i++) {
+    if (!slots_[i].shapeCache.shapeStatic) {
+      slots_[i].shapeCache.cachedShapeKey = 0;
+      slots_[i].shapeCache.cachedOutputShapes.clear();
+      // Demote to WARMUP if currently beyond warmup (non-static slots need re-inference)
+      if (slots_[i].state_ > NativeSlot::SlotState::WARMUP) {
+        slots_[i].state_ = NativeSlot::SlotState::WARMUP;
       }
     }
   }

  1581	void NativeDynamicShapePlan::advancePlanPhase() {
  1582	  // ── Plan-level phase advancement ───────────────────────────────────────────
  1583	  // Phase transitions are automatic based on observed stability:
  1584	  //   SHAPES_FROZEN → POINTERS_STABLE: after 2+ frozen executions with every
  1585	  //                                     replay-eligible segment in pointer-stable state
  1586	  //   POINTERS_STABLE → REPLAYING:     when every replay-eligible segment reaches
  1587	  //                                     backend-specific replay steady state
  1588	  //
  1589	  // Caller is responsible for: incrementing frozenExecutionCount_, capturing
  1590	  // frozenSnapshot_ on first frozen execution.
  1591	  if (!shapesFrozen_ || planPhase_ < PlanPhase::SHAPES_FROZEN) return;
  1592	
  1593	  // Check pointer stability across all replay-eligible segments.
  1594	  if (planPhase_ == PlanPhase::SHAPES_FROZEN && frozenExecutionCount_ >= 2) {
  1595	    bool allStable = true;
  1596	    for (auto& seg : segments_) {
  1597	      if (!segmentHasStablePointersForPlanPhase(seg, slots_)) {
  1598	        allStable = false;
  1599	        break;
  1600	      }
  1601	    }
  1602	    if (allStable) {
  1603	      pointersStable_ = true;
  1604	      const char* oldPhase = dsp::planPhaseName(planPhase_);
  1605	      planPhase_ = PlanPhase::POINTERS_STABLE;
  1606	      DSP_DIAG(EXECUTE, "PLAN_PHASE: %s → POINTERS_STABLE (frozenExec=%d)",
  1607	               oldPhase, frozenExecutionCount_);
  1608	    }
  1609	  }
  1610	
  1611	  // Promote to REPLAYING only once every replay-eligible segment has reached
  1612	  // steady-state replay. Mixed-phase plans stay at POINTERS_STABLE.
  1613	  if (planPhase_ >= PlanPhase::POINTERS_STABLE) {
  1614	    bool hasReplayEligibleSegment = false;
  1615	    bool allReplaying = true;
  1616	    for (auto& seg : segments_) {
  1617	      if (!segmentBlocksPlanPhase(seg)) continue;
  1618	      hasReplayEligibleSegment = true;
  1619	      if (!segmentIsFullyReplayingForPlanPhase(seg, slots_)) {
  1620	        allReplaying = false;
  1621	        break;
  1622	      }
  1623	    }
  1624	    if (hasReplayEligibleSegment && allReplaying && planPhase_ != PlanPhase::REPLAYING) {
  1625	      const char* oldPhase = dsp::planPhaseName(planPhase_);
  1626	      planPhase_ = PlanPhase::REPLAYING;
  1627	      DSP_DIAG(EXECUTE, "PLAN_PHASE: %s → REPLAYING (frozenExec=%d)",
  1628	               oldPhase, frozenExecutionCount_);
  1629	    }
  1630	  }
  1631	}

  - Modify [NativeDynamicShapePlan_slotexec.cpp](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/impl/NativeDynamicShapePlan_slotexec.cpp:1364) to emit a `VERIFY/MEMORY` event whenever frozen reuse skips nullify, and whenever `cached2-reuse` is taken.   - Modify `nd4j/.../DynamicShapePlanExecutor.java`
  - Modify `libnd4j/include/graph/impl/NativeDynamicShapePlan.cpp`
  - Modify `libnd4j/include/graph/impl/NativeDynamicShapePlan_slotexec.cpp`

- **Minimal tests that expose each risk**
  - Prefill handoff: compare `step1` and `step2` logits for the same prompt between `skipFreeze=true` and native frozen+scatter, under both `GEM_SLOT_BY_SLOT` and non-slot-by-slot mode.
  - KV scatter: after one decode step, assert the static KV slice at `cachePos=prefillLen` matches the last slice of the present KV outputs from the Java-scatter path.
  - Stale reuse: run the same frozen plan twice with identical inputs and native scatter disabled; outputs must be identical. This isolates buffer reuse from decode-state evolution.
  - Max-alloc reuse: force a shape that enters `cached2-reuse`; compare against a path that allocates fresh outputs each time.
  - End-to-end oracle: extend the real VLM quality test past `10` tokens on the mythic PDF workload; the current short synthetic oracle is too weak for this seam.

- **DSP diagnostics to use**
  - Handoff/mode: `COMPILE | SHAPE | EXECUTE | BACKEND`, level `FULL`
  - KV mapping/scatter: `KV_CACHE | EXECUTE | VERIFY | STREAM_SYNC`, level `FULL`
  - Stale output reuse: `MEMORY | VERIFY | EXECUTE | FALLBACK`, level `FULL`
  - Replay/capture ordering: `GRAPH_REPLAY | EXECUTE | STREAM_SYNC`, level `FULL`

**Migration / Compatibility / Risk**

No public API or model-format migration is needed. The safest path is diagnostics-first, keep all new logging behind existing DSP diagnostic flags, and preserve Java scatter as the control path. The main risk is “fixing” quality by blanket re-zeroing, which would likely reintroduce the memory/leak regression that `47a24d3ce4` addressed. The root-cause fix should therefore be either a wrong KV mapping/position update or a narrow `needsZeroedOutput`/op-trait correction, not a global rollback of frozen reuse.

- The static KV buffers come from [StaticKvCacheManager.java](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/nd4j/samediff-llm/src/main/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/llm/generation/StaticKvCacheManager.java:115) lines `115-128`, and on decode they are passed to the plan as full padded external inputs in [DecoderUtils.java](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/nd4j/samediff-llm/src/main/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/llm/generation/DecoderUtils.java:773) lines `773-780`.
- Mode handling is correct in the current code: Java preserves the pre-refactor mode across recompile in [DynamicShapePlanExecutor.java](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/nd4j/nd4j-backends/nd4j-api-parent/nd4j-api/src/main/java/org/nd4j/autodiff/samediff/execution/DynamicShapePlanExecutor.java:1091) lines `1091-1092` and [StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop.java](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/nd4j/samediff-llm/src/main/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/llm/generation/StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop.java:643) lines `643-653`. Native dispatch then does first frozen execution as warmup, not replay, in [NativeDynamicShapePlan.cpp](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/impl/NativeDynamicShapePlan.cpp:1262) lines `1262-1283`. If mode is `GEM_SLOT_BY_SLOT`, it stays slot-by-slot after that; otherwise later calls can replay.
- `outputDirect` is not active at the handoff boundary. [StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop.java](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/nd4j/samediff-llm/src/main/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/llm/generation/StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop.java:456) lines `456-470` require `step >= 2`, so the first post-prefill decode token is not a direct-output aliasing bug.

- **Task 2, nullify suppression:** there is no plan-wide `nullify()` pass anymore; zeroing is now per-slot. The critical logic is in [NativeDynamicShapePlan_slotexec.cpp](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/impl/NativeDynamicShapePlan_slotexec.cpp:1364) lines `1364-1405`. In frozen mode, once `shapesFrozen_ && executeCount_ >= 2`, reused outputs skip `nullify()` unless `slot.flags.needsZeroedOutput` is true. Capture/replay also suppresses nullify through `tl_graphExecutionActive`, set only for compile/replay phases in [NativeDynamicShapePlan_segments.cpp](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/impl/NativeDynamicShapePlan_segments.cpp:685) lines `685-699`.
- `writeOutputSlot()` in [NativeDynamicShapePlan.cpp](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/impl/NativeDynamicShapePlan.cpp:253) lines `253-341` now deletes replaced plan-owned arrays inline if no other slot points to the same `NDArray*`. After `POINTERS_STABLE`, it throws if a slot’s `DataBuffer*` changes.
- The stale-data risk is real in two places:
  - frozen fast-path skip-nullify, if `needsZeroedOutput` is wrong
  - max-allocation reuse in [NativeDynamicShapePlan_slotexec.cpp](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/impl/NativeDynamicShapePlan_slotexec.cpp:2210) lines `2210-2215`, which reuses `cached2` with no nullify at all
- The correctness contract comes from [NativePlanCompiler.cpp](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/impl/NativePlanCompiler.cpp:261) lines `261-274`: `needsZeroedOutput=false` means the op is assumed fully writing and not data-dependent. If that trait is wrong for any decode-path op, old contents can bleed across steps.

- **Task 3, `outputSlots_` unification:** commit `89d1f28925` is probably not the behavioral regression. Current [NativeDynamicShapePlan.h](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/NativeDynamicShapePlan.h:1289) lines `1289-1292` and `1699-1702` explicitly document that `slotArrayCache_` was already aliased to `outputSlots_`; the commit removed redundant state and left a macro alias for compatibility. The historical diff shows the same pointer alias existed before the commit. The risk is not “cache A vs cache B diverged”; it is “code still assumes distinct lifetimes even though there is one slot storage.”
- A raw external alias to an old `NDArray*` can still be invalidated by inline delete in `writeOutputSlot()`. That risk belongs to `47a24d3ce4`, not `89d1f28925`.

- **Task 4, native KV scatter:** Java resolves KV retention by name in [DynamicShapePlanExecutor.java](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/nd4j/nd4j-backends/nd4j-api-parent/nd4j-api/src/main/java/org/nd4j/autodiff/samediff/execution/DynamicShapePlanExecutor.java:628) lines `628-683`; `findOutputSlotIndex()` in lines `590-610` can still find present-KV slots even when requested outputs are logits-only. Native decodes those mappings in [NativeDynamicShapePlan.cpp](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/impl/NativeDynamicShapePlan.cpp:2256) lines `2256-2283`.
- The actual scatter is in [NativeDynamicShapePlan.cpp](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/impl/NativeDynamicShapePlan.cpp:2347) lines `2347-2448`: it takes `outputSlots_[presentSlotIdx]`, reads only the last source timestep (`lastPos = srcSeqLen - 1`), and writes it into the static external input buffer at `kvCachePosition_`.
- Scatter is outside CUDA graph capture/replay, not inside it: [NativeDynamicShapePlan.cpp](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/impl/NativeDynamicShapePlan.cpp:1352) lines `1352-1355` and [NativeDynamicShapePlan_cuda.cu](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/impl/NativeDynamicShapePlan_cuda.cu:249) lines `249-252`. CUDA then hard-syncs after scatter in [NativeDynamicShapePlan_cuda.cu](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/impl/NativeDynamicShapePlan_cuda.cu:1292) lines `1292-1302`.
- If scatter writes the wrong position, decode quality degrades silently: the model attends to a corrupted static KV history. If `kvCachePosition_ >= dstSeq`, the write is skipped, which is also silent quality loss. Java keeps its own counter in sync in [StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop.java](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/nd4j/samediff-llm/src/main/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/llm/generation/StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop.java:533) lines `533-538`.

**Exact Hotspots And Invariants**

- Highest-risk seam: [StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop.java](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/nd4j/samediff-llm/src/main/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/llm/generation/StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop.java:614) lines `614-715`. Invariant: after recompile, `shapesFrozen=true`, static KV buffers are bound, and `kvScatterInCpp` only becomes true if every present->past mapping resolved.
- Highest-risk native retention seam: [DynamicShapePlanExecutor.java](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/nd4j/nd4j-backends/nd4j-api-parent/nd4j-api/src/main/java/org/nd4j/autodiff/samediff/execution/DynamicShapePlanExecutor.java:647) lines `647-657` plus [NativeDynamicShapePlan.cpp](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/impl/NativeDynamicShapePlan.cpp:2373) lines `2373-2425`. Invariant: every mapping points to the intended present slot and past external input, and `cachePos` advances exactly once per decode step in native and once in Java bookkeeping.
- Highest-risk stale-buffer seam: [NativeDynamicShapePlan_slotexec.cpp](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/impl/NativeDynamicShapePlan_slotexec.cpp:1364) lines `1364-1405` and `2210-2215`. Invariant: any reused buffer that skips nullify must be fully overwritten by the op.
- Highest-risk ownership seam: [NativeDynamicShapePlan.cpp](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/impl/NativeDynamicShapePlan.cpp:313) lines `313-330`. Invariant: no live consumer outside `outputSlots_` depends on an old plan-owned `NDArray*` after replacement.
- Phase invariant: [NativeDynamicShapePlan.cpp](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/impl/NativeDynamicShapePlan.cpp:1581) lines `1581-1629`. `POINTERS_STABLE` and `REPLAYING` must not be entered while any slot still changes backing buffers.

**Concrete Diagnostic Plan**

- **Proposed code changes, with rationale**
  - Modify [DynamicShapePlanExecutor.java](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/nd4j/nd4j-backends/nd4j-api-parent/nd4j-api/src/main/java/org/nd4j/autodiff/samediff/execution/DynamicShapePlanExecutor.java:628) to emit the resolved `presentName -> slotIdx -> pastExtIdx` mapping under `KV_CACHE`. This separates name-resolution bugs from native scatter bugs.
  - Modify [NativeDynamicShapePlan.cpp](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/impl/NativeDynamicShapePlan.cpp:2347) to log `presentSlotIdx`, `srcSeqLen`, `dstSeqLen`, `cachePos`, and whether the scatter entry was skipped. This will expose off-by-one or wrong-slot writes immediately.
  - Modify [NativeDynamicShapePlan_slotexec.cpp](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/impl/NativeDynamicShapePlan_slotexec.cpp:1364) to emit a `VERIFY/MEMORY` event whenever frozen reuse skips nullify, and whenever `cached2-reuse` is taken. This is the smallest way to catch stale-buffer candidates without changing behavior.
  - Only if a concrete offender appears, modify [NativePlanCompiler.cpp](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/impl/NativePlanCompiler.cpp:261) or the offending op trait source, not the whole frozen-reuse policy.

- **Files to create/modify**
  - Modify `nd4j/.../DynamicShapePlanExecutor.java`
  - Modify `libnd4j/include/graph/impl/NativeDynamicShapePlan.cpp`
  - Modify `libnd4j/include/graph/impl/NativeDynamicShapePlan_slotexec.cpp`
  - Modify `platform-tests/src/test/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/vlm/TestStaticKvVsManualDecode.java`

  - If needed, add `platform-tests/src/test/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/nd4j/autodiff/samediff/TestDSPKvScatterPositioning.java`

- **Minimal tests that expose each risk**
  - Prefill handoff: compare `step1` and `step2` logits for the same prompt between `skipFreeze=true` and native frozen+scatter, under both `GEM_SLOT_BY_SLOT` and non-slot-by-slot mode.
  - KV scatter: after one decode step, assert the static KV slice at `cachePos=prefillLen` matches the last slice of the present KV outputs from the Java-scatter path.
  - Stale reuse: run the same frozen plan twice with identical inputs and native scatter disabled; outputs must be identical. This isolates buffer reuse from decode-state evolution.
  - Max-alloc reuse: force a shape that enters `cached2-reuse`; compare against a path that allocates fresh outputs each time.
  - End-to-end oracle: extend the real VLM quality test past `10` tokens on the mythic PDF workload; the current short synthetic oracle is too weak for this seam.

- **DSP diagnostics to use**
  - Handoff/mode: `COMPILE | SHAPE | EXECUTE | BACKEND`, level `FULL`
  - KV mapping/scatter: `KV_CACHE | EXECUTE | VERIFY | STREAM_SYNC`, level `FULL`
  - Stale output reuse: `MEMORY | VERIFY | EXECUTE | FALLBACK`, level `FULL`
  - Replay/capture ordering: `GRAPH_REPLAY | EXECUTE | STREAM_SYNC`, level `FULL`
  - Categories and levels are defined in [DspDiagnostics.h](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/DspDiagnostics.h:41) lines `41-70`

**Migration / Compatibility / Risk**

No public API or model-format migration is needed. The safest path is diagnostics-first, keep all new logging behind existing DSP diagnostic flags, and preserve Java scatter as the control path. The main risk is “fixing” quality by blanket re-zeroing, which would likely reintroduce the memory/leak regression that `47a24d3ce4` addressed. The root-cause fix should therefore be either a wrong KV mapping/position update or a narrow `needsZeroedOutput`/op-trait correction, not a global rollback of frozen reuse.

No files were modified in this investigation.
